string.name: levelDesc.1
string.value: It's Denise's first day on the job! Can she learn the ropes with only one employee to help her?

string.name: levelDesc.2
string.value: Timothy's a financial whiz... and a stress case! Keep him chill, but get those tasks done!

string.name: levelDesc.3
string.value: The boys start to panic when a pile of art tasks show up... Luckily, so does an artist!

string.name: levelDesc.4
string.value: Tara just wants to be alone to draw. Mahavir wants to chat her up. Whatcha gonna do?

string.name: levelDesc.5
string.value: He knows everything there is to know about technical tasks. Which rubs Tim wrong...

string.name: levelDesc.6
string.value: Timothy's turned over a new leaf... Can the office survive his change of heart?

string.name: levelDesc.7
string.value: Pearl was the bossy queen of the office... until Denise came to town. Now she's back!

string.name: levelDesc.8
string.value: What are these purple tasks? Writing? And why is Pearl insisting that Tara do them?

string.name: levelDesc.9
string.value: Denise has found a solution to the writing task problem, but Pearl's not pleased...

string.name: levelDesc.10
string.value: Videogames, ailing hippies, and Pearl picking on Tara... just another day at the office!

string.name: levelDesc.11
string.value: Tara can't get a moment's peace. Mahavir's hitting on her, and Pearl... she's just mean!

string.name: levelDesc.12
string.value: Whoa... Is Tara finally standing up to Pearl? Time for an office showdown!

string.name: levelDesc.13
string.value: There's a new boss in town, and he likes to do things his way... the manly way!

string.name: levelDesc.14
string.value: Duncan's insisting that everyone do tasks they're not good at! This is management?

string.name: levelDesc.15
string.value: Now he's telling everyone to stop working so much?! And who's this new girl... his niece?

string.name: levelDesc.16
string.value: Luke and Ashley can't share a bathroom, and Winston's had it up to here with Duncan...

string.name: levelDesc.17
string.value: Mahavir's back with one thing on his mind... and it's not all the work that needs doing!

string.name: levelDesc.18
string.value: Duncan's mysteriously vanished... someone's got to be in charge! Is Denise up to it?

string.name: levelDesc.19
string.value: Pearl's done a makeover of the office, and it ain't pretty. Neither are her plans!

string.name: levelDesc.20
string.value: Pearl's "cross-skill workout" continues, and Nadine isn't taking kindly to Luke.

string.name: levelDesc.21
string.value: What, no snacks? Pearl is really cracking down on employee morale...

string.name: levelDesc.22
string.value: Pearl and Nadine are determined to squash yet another pest keeping them from dominating the office.

string.name: levelDesc.23
string.value: After a series of bad dates, Ashley's fed up with slacker boys, while Pearl is just fed up in general!

string.name: levelDesc.24
string.value: The truth behind Project PEARL is about to be revealed...

string.name: levelDesc.25
string.value: Denise and the team have been summoned to the offices of the mysterious Conkling CEO.

string.name: levelDesc.26
string.value: Winston and Denise discover that not all is well in the higher echelons of the corporation...

string.name: levelDesc.27
string.value: Ashley's landed the man of her dreams at last... but can Denise get by with a staff of four?

string.name: levelDesc.28
string.value: CEO Syndrome strikes! Brooke can't handle working as part of a team anymore.

string.name: levelDesc.29
string.value: Mahavir's left town in Denise's hour of need, but who has he sent in as a replacement?

string.name: levelDesc.30
string.value: In which our heroes and heroines discover at last how to balance work and play... Or will they?

string.name: epilogueText.Brooke
string.value: Brooke started a new company that recently earned a five-star rating for its employee quality of life. She's finally learned to delegate and spends two hours every morning doing Yoga.

string.name: epilogueText.Winston
string.value: Winston is still working at C.A.I. -- and somehow wound up as the Chief Technology Officer, despite his best efforts. He still has the high score in ZAP! and not-so-secretly spends time burning copies of his jazz quartet's latest CD to give to his friends.

string.name: epilogueText.Pearl
string.value: Pearl retired and moved to be closer to her daughter's family. She spends a lot of time encouraging her grandchildren with motivational posters, and is considering starting a new career... as a middle school vice principal.

string.name: epilogueText.Nadine
string.value: Nadine is currently attempting to seize power by becoming the new CEO of Conkling Associates, Intl. She considers Winston her arch-enemy.

string.name: epilogueText.Timothy
string.value: Timothy invented an amazing new stress-relief device: a special wig that you can tear hair out of in clumps to prevent damage to your own scalp while relieving tension. He's made millions, but it's not clear what the wig has to do with stroganoff. Everyone is afraid to ask.

string.name: epilogueText.Duncan
string.value: The gym that Duncan started along with his partner became a local chain, with branches in all the trendy neighborhoods. He's considering adopting an orphan from China (a boy, of course) and is spending a lot of time picking out baseball mitts.

string.name: epilogueText.Ashley
string.value: Ashley's first marriage ended tragically when she annulled it on grounds of "he bought me an imitation Versace bag." Fortunately, she found an "even better lawyer boy" three months later at a party in the Hamptons. She's happily married and living on the Upper East Side of Manhattan.

string.name: epilogueText.Tara
string.value: Tara spent a couple of years drawing her magnum opus manga, "Cubicle Carnation Dreams." The series has a fan following of thousands, who attend her book signings wearing elaborate homemade costumes of characters like "Demon Sorceress Pearlatia."

string.name: epilogueText.Denise
string.value: Denise moved to Paris to attend graduate school at the world-famous Sorbonne. She went on to become a renowned psychotherapist... specializing in mild neuroses, workplace issues, and stress disorders.

string.name: epilogueText.Luke
string.value: Luke moved back from Amsterdam after a couple months. Despite some trouble with customs, he managed to relocate to Vancouver and start his own all-natural organic coffeeshop.

string.name: epilogueText.Mahavir
string.value: Mahavir's corporate self-help bible, "The Eternal Wisdom of Mahavir," became an instant bestseller. That didn't prevent his family from tracking him down and dragging him back to Delhi to get married to the daughter of a family friend. He mysteriously vanished from his engagement party, and was last seen on a train... heading for Paris.

string.name: cutscene.DeniseHalfStress.Explanation
string.value: Denise is getting stressed out because there are too many overdue tasks! You'd better get your employees working on them before the head office reconsiders hiring her...

string.name: cutscene.EmployeeDie.Whoops
string.value: Whoops, looks like %employeeName% got way too stressed out and had to go home...

string.name: cutscene.EmployeeDie.DontWorry
string.value: Don't worry, they'll be back tomorrow, but they're definitely not getting any more work done today, and you can forget about any goals they had!

string.name: cutscene.EmployeeHalfStress.GettingStressed
string.value: %employeeName% is looking pretty stressed out! If an employee's stress meter reaches maximum, they'll burn out and have to go home for the day.

string.name: cutscene.EmployeeHalfStress.WaterCooler
string.value: The water cooler can be pretty useful for letting go of stress. Most employees can also relax by taking breaks at other locations they like to frequent...

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.DeniseRightPlace
string.value: Weird... this is definitely the address in my acceptance letter!

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.DeniseHello2
string.value: Hello? Is anyone here?

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirWakes
string.value: Grmmmh...

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirWakes2
string.value: Huh? What?

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirSorrow
string.value: Ah! It is my sorrow to turn away such a stunning young flower...

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirClosed
string.value: ... but I'm afraid we're closed!

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.DeniseReport
string.value: I was told to report here for a job. I'm the new office manager, y'see...

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirReally
string.value: Whoa, no way!

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirReally2
string.value: I mean... how about that!

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirGazelle
string.value: Yes! A new sexy gazelle in the office! A new challenge... for Mahavir!

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.DeniseHearYou
string.value: Um... I can still hear you.

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.DeniseConkling
string.value: This IS Conkling Associates International, right?

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirIndeed
string.value: Indeed it is, m'dear. C.A.I. for short.

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirMahavir
string.value: And I... am Mahavir!

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirRopes
string.value: Naturally, you'll need a new friend to show you the ropes around here, right?

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.DeniseDenise
string.value: Uh... sure, why not? My name's Denise, by the way.

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.DeniseDenise2
string.value: So does anyone work here besides you?

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirHolidays
string.value: Oh, it's barely past New Year's. We're a small branch office, and everyone's gone home for the holidays.

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.DeniseSleeping
string.value: And you're just... here by yourself? Sleeping?

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirFamily
string.value: Well, I didn't feel like going all the way back to Bombay.

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirDelhi
string.value: It's a 23-hour flight, but if I stay here and hang around the office, I get paid!

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.DeniseISee
string.value: I see... !

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirTasks
string.value: Oops, break's over! They'll start sending tasks for us any minute.

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirDesk
string.value: Quick, see that long desk in the corner?

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.DenisePhone
string.value: Oh... um, you mean the one over there with the phone?

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirManual
string.value: Yep, that's the one! Let me just find the new employee orientation manual...

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirActivity
string.value: Welcome to your first day at C.A.I., Denise! You're joining a team providing industry-leading solutions for... blah blah blah, this stuff doesn't matter...

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirDocument
string.value: Here's the important part. That long desk is yours, and that document that just appeared on it is a TASK!

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirPronto
string.value: The central office sent it over, and they want it done pronto! You'd better go pick it up and put it on my desk...

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirSuppose
string.value: I suppose I can do SOME work today...

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirOneSec
string.value: Now watch in amazement as I expertly polish off this task!

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirBudget
string.value: Every time I finish a task, the central office raises our petty cash budget a bit!

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirSnacks
string.value: If we want money to buy snacks and office supplies, I'll have to keep working...

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirMoreTasks
string.value: New tasks will keep showing up on your desk until closing time! They definitely like to keep us busy.

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirKeepEm
string.value: Just keep 'em comin', cute stuff!

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirSexy
string.value: You know what? All work and no play makes Mahavir... less sexy than usual!

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirGoals
string.value: Drudging away at this busywork is not what's really important in life, is it? We all have other goals.

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirBreak
string.value: Personally, my plans for today involved sleeping on the couch over there. I know... you can help me take a break!

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirCouch
string.value: Just click on me and then on the couch, and I'll get right on it!

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirWakeLater
string.value: Ahh, I can feel the stress vanishing from my shoulders already... wake me up later!

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.InstructionsStressPre
string.value: Employees like Mahavir get a little stressed out when they work on tasks, but they have ways of relaxing too.

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.InstructionsStress
string.value: You can tell that Mahavir is less stressed out when the red level of his Stress Thermometer goes down.

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.InstructionsGoals
string.value: To finish an episode and move on in the story, Denise has to help her fellow employees finish their goals.

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.InstructionsInformation
string.value: You can see the goals for this episode on the top of the screen. Move your mouse over the goals for more information.

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.InstructionsTab
string.value: You can also see a list of the goals for this episode by opening the GOAL INFO tab. Try opening it now.

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.InstructionsProgress
string.value: Keep track of the progress of Mahavir's goals by watching the goal meters fill up!

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirTrouble
string.value: Uh oh... you'll get in trouble if you let tasks become overdue! Too many of those and your job might be on the line!

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.DeniseStress
string.value: Denise will become more stressed out when overdue tasks are in the office.

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.DeniseStress2
string.value: If she becomes totally stressed out, you'll have to start the day over!

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirCheeks
string.value: Don't freak out, sweet cheeks! I guess we can deal with that pesky task before I get back to more important things...

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirDistress
string.value: I never could resist a damsel in distress... Just click on the task, then on my desk!

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirNextTask
string.value: You can bring tasks to my desk even when I'm not there... But if you want me to get to work, you'd better send me back there too.

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirLater
string.value: I only got through part of my nap... but that's OK, I'll just pick up where I left off later.

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirOneDay
string.value: Some goals are the kind of thing you have to get done in one day...

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirTomorrow
string.value: But beauty sleep I can always catch up on tomorrow if we run out of time!

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirAllThereIs
string.value: ...and that's all there is to it!

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.DeniseThink
string.value: Hmm, I think I get how it works!

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirGoodJob
string.value: Good job! We got through the day and the office finally has some petty cash again!

string.name: cutscene.01Intro.MahavirTomorrowDonuts
string.value: Tomorrow I'll show you where to buy donuts... Donuts are half the reason I stay in this country!

string.name: cutscene.01-2Intro.MahavirWelcomeBack
string.value: Ahh, welcome back to another exciting day at your new job! I was hoping to ask you a favor...

string.name: cutscene.01-2Intro.MahavirNeedsDonut
string.value: I don't think I'm going to be able to make it through the day without a donut... can you go pick us up some? Pleeeeeease?

string.name: cutscene.01-2Intro.MahavirMoreGoals
string.value: As you can see from the post-its above, Mahavir still has a couple goals he wants some help with.

string.name: cutscene.01-2Intro.MahavirGoalThink
string.value: Sometimes you'll see Mahavir think about one of his goals too.

string.name: cutscene.01-2Intro.MahavirGoalDetails
string.value: He wants to nap some more, and eat a donut. You have as many days as you need to finish all the goals for the episode, so there's no rush!

string.name: cutscene.01-2Intro.MahavirFinishGoalsFast
string.value: However, if you can finish every single goal fast enough, you could earn a bonus for your performance...

string.name: cutscene.01-2Intro.MahavirOfficeTownIntro
string.value: We get most of our snacks and office supplies from OfficeTown, across the street. Take some petty cash and check it out!

string.name: cutscene.01-2Intro.MahavirDeniseBudget
string.value: Denise can use the office budget to buy various items that can boost productivity and lower stress, among other things.

string.name: cutscene.01-2Intro.MahavirSendToStore
string.value: Try sending her to the store now. Be sure to buy at least one donut for Mahavir!

string.name: cutscene.01-2Intro.MahavirAwesomeDonuts
string.value: Awesome, donuts! I can tell you'll go far at this company! At least with me... Can you bring me one?

string.name: cutscene.01-2Intro.MahavirGoalMoraleBoost
string.value: Whenever an employee finishes a goal, the entire office gets a morale boost, which reduces everyone's stress.

string.name: cutscene.01-2Intro.MahavirDeniseRelaxed
string.value: Right now, there's not much effect since Denise and Mahavir are pretty relaxed... but it'll come in handy later!

string.name: cutscene.01-2Intro.MahavirOptionalGoals
string.value: Sometimes when employees finish one goal, another one appears! Goals with orange backgrounds are optional.

string.name: cutscene.01-2Intro.MahavirBonusStar
string.value: You don't have to finish optional goals to complete an episode. But if you get every goal in the episode done, you'll earn a bonus star!

string.name: cutscene.01-2Intro.MahavirHitTheSpot
string.value: Thanks, cute stuff! That really hit the spot. Although now that I think about it... I guess I could squeeze in a couple more if I really tried!

string.name: cutscene.01-2Intro.MahavirBeautyRest
string.value: My only other important goal for the day is to finish my beauty rest...

string.name: cutscene.01-2Intro.MahavirYouDecide
string.value: But heck, you're the new office manager, you can decide when it's time for a break!

string.name: cutscene.01-2Intro.MahavirFinishedGoals
string.value: Great, I've finished all of my most important goals! Ahh, nothing beats that feeling of satisfaction at a job well done.

string.name: cutscene.01-2Intro.MahavirJobLongNap
string.value: And by job, what I really mean is... taking a long nap!

string.name: cutscene.01-2Intro.DeniseWhatsUp
string.value: Sure, what's up?

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.DeniseHang
string.value: Well, that wasn't so bad... for my first day on the job! I think I'm getting the hang of it...

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.DeniseStrange
string.value: It's all kinda strange though. Mahavir has this whole place to himself? He seems nice, even if he is a bit...

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.MahavirDanger
string.value: A bit suave? A bit sophisticated... with just a hint of mystery and danger?

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.MahavirSunshine
string.value: Good morning, sunshine! Do you always talk to yourself when you're alone?

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.DeniseFigure
string.value: Well... only when I'm trying to figure something out, really.

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.MahavirTimothy
string.value: Hmm, I thought I should tell you... Timothy's back in the office today.

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.MahavirAccountant
string.value: He's the office's accountant. Real whiz with numbers, so you can give him any financial tasks that come in, instead of making me do them!

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.MahavirWell
string.value: But he's a little, well...

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.TimothyEveryone
string.value: Oh my. Oh my. What's going on? Where is everyone?

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.MahavirHolidays
string.value: Hi Timmy! Most everyone's still gone for the holidays, remember?

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.TimothyMahavir
string.value: Oh. Mahavir.

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.TimothyPearl
string.value: Please don't call me Timmy... I asked you not to call me Timmy. Who's this girl...? Where's Pearl? Where's Pearl?

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.MahavirDenise
string.value: Pearl didn't get the job, oddly enough... this is our new office manager, Denise!

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.TimothyWorrying
string.value: What? This is very worrying!

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.TimothyHandle
string.value: Do you know what you're doing, miss? As well as Pearl? Can you handle it?

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.DeniseTasks
string.value: Well... yes, I can! I just take the tasks and I...

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.TimothyTasks
string.value: Oh... oh! The tasks! You'll have to be quick about that... there's so much work we need to get done.

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.TimothyWaiting
string.value: I know there are tasks left over from before the holidays! I'll be at my desk, waiting for them. Waiting.

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.MahavirSee
string.value: See what I mean?

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.DeniseLittle
string.value: Yeah, he's a little...

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.MahavirBasketcase
string.value: Skittish? Anxious? A total basketcase?

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.DeniseWorried
string.value: Oh dear... I'm worried about him!

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.MahavirWork
string.value: Oh, don't be. He loves being at work.

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.MahavirCooler
string.value: If he gets too stressed out, just get him to take a break at the water cooler!

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.InstructionsCooler
string.value: The water cooler will help any employee lose stress, but it's not as relaxing as other locations.

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.InstructionsCooler2
string.value: Mahavir, for instance, relaxes best when he's lying on his couch! Every employee has at least one favorite spot...

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.MahavirCouch
string.value: I'm gonna rest for a bit, OK? I was out late last night and I need some more, you know...

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.DeniseCoffee
string.value: Some more coffee?

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.MahavirSleep
string.value: Some more beauty sleep!

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.MahavirFinalWords
string.value: Just remember... Timothy's better at those financial tasks than me!

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.TaskColorInstructions
string.value: Different kinds of tasks have different colors. Here's a financial task and a technical task.

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.ArrowInstructions
string.value: Some employees excel at certain kinds of tasks, while others aren't as good at them.

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.ArrowInstructions2
string.value: You can tell which employees are better at tasks by the arrows on their desks.

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.BudgetInstructions
string.value: One last thing you should know: your petty cash budget starts over every level! Scoring lots of money is only good for the record books...

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.DeniseArrowComment
string.value: Mahavir's just OK at everything, it looks like... but Timothy's good at financial stuff!

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.ArrowInstructions4
string.value: Employees finish work they're good at faster and get less stressed out as a result!

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.TimothySlacks
string.value: Augh! I hate it when he just... just slacks off like that! It drives me crazy!

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.TimothySlacks2
string.value: Watch out... Some employees get more stressed out if other employees do something they don't like!

string.name: cutscene.02Intro.TimothySlacks3
string.value: The jagged red bubble over Timothy's head shows you what's bothering him. Keep an eye on his stress level!

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.TimothySending
string.value: They keep sending them over! Aaah! What are we going to do? What?

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.MahavirArtist
string.value: How should I know? I'm not an artist either!

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.DeniseGuys
string.value: Hey guys... what's going on?

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.TimothyGoingOn
string.value: What's going on? What's going on? We're DOOMED, that's what's going on!

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.MahavirOrange
string.value: See this orange task on Timmy's desk?

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.MahavirArtTask
string.value: It's an art task. Visuals, designs, presentations, that sort of thing!

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.MahavirBunch
string.value: The central office is sending over a whole bunch of them today...

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.MahavirNeither
string.value: Problem is, neither of us are any good at art.

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.MahavirBadTaskStress
string.value: And it's really stressful to work on stuff you're no good at, believe me!

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.TimothyMahavir
string.value: You... Mahavir, you're better at that art stuff than ME! I'm the one who really gets stressed out by art tasks !

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.MahavirNotHard
string.value: Well sure, it's not hard to be better at it than YOU...

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.MahavirCallus
string.value: But I can't spend all day drawing. I might develop a callus!

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.TimothyOhMyGod
string.value: Oh my god... oh my god... what are we going to...

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.DeniseSomething
string.value: Well, I'm sure there's something...

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.TaraHi
string.value: Hi guys.

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.TaraNewLady
string.value: Um... who's that new lady?

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.DeniseDenise
string.value: Oh! Hi there, I'm Denise. I'm the new office manager, and you must be... Tara?

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.TaraDenise
string.value: Oh. Uh... nice to meet you, Miss Denise.

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.TaraBye
string.value: Um... bye!

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.MahavirShy
string.value: Psst! Tara's kinda shy, so don't worry about it.

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.MahavirGoodNews
string.value: The good news is, she's an artist!

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.TimothySaved
string.value: We're saved! Art tasks... I thought I was going to have a coronary...

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.TimothySaved2
string.value: It'll all be fine... I'll do the financial tasks, and Tara can do the art tasks... It'll all be fine!

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.TimothyStroganoff
string.value: I've got to go make some stroganoff.

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.MahavirStroganoff
string.value: The guy's only comfort in life is beef stroganoff. Don't ask. I can't stand the smell of the stuff.

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.MahavirArtTasks
string.value: Listen, just give Tara all those art tasks, and don't forget about the water cooler! She likes taking breaks too.

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.MahavirPeach
string.value: Thanks, you're a peach! I'll be over here!

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.TimothyBeefy
string.value: Sweet, sweet beefy stroganoff... you always make me feel better!

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.DeniseWeirdest
string.value: This is the weirdest job I've ever had!

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.DeniseOnly
string.value: Sure, the ONLY job I've ever had... but definitely the weirdest!

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.InstructionsArt
string.value: Tara's the one who's good at art tasks, but it looks like Timothy's still got one on his desk!

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.InstructionsDesk
string.value: Denise can pick up tasks from one desk and take them to another desk. Try it now!

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.TaraSleep
string.value: Are you going to let Mahavir sleep all day like Pearl does? It's... not fair... Timothy doesn't like it either!

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.DeniseFigureOut
string.value: Don't worry, Tara... I'm sure we can figure it all out...

string.name: cutscene.03Intro.TaraWantsMarkers
string.value: And I'm out of markers... I could really use some more, miss.

string.name: cutscene.04Intro.MahavirRedhead
string.value: This new girl, Denise. She is an extremely vivacious redhead. I can tell. So sassy!

string.name: cutscene.04Intro.TimothyUm
string.value: Um... I don't think... um...

string.name: cutscene.04Intro.MahavirPrey
string.value: But you must understand, I cannot neglect my existing commitments! I have long been in pursuit of... other prey!

string.name: cutscene.04Intro.TimothyOtherThings
string.value: Don't you ever think about anything besides... you know... um...

string.name: cutscene.04Intro.MahavirDrawing
string.value: Long has she eluded me, wrapped in that mysterious lavender sweater, always at her whiteboard, drawing.

string.name: cutscene.04Intro.MahavirDate
string.value: But Tara shall be mine! Soon... we will DATE.

string.name: cutscene.04Intro.MahavirDate2
string.value: I just need a little time to chat her up at the water cooler...

string.name: cutscene.04Intro.TimothyHandbook
string.value: This conversation is specifically prohibited in the Employee Handbook, I'm sure of it!

string.name: cutscene.04Intro.DeniseTara
string.value: Oh, so you're interested in Tara, eh?

string.name: cutscene.04Intro.MahavirCucumber
string.value: Denise. Liebchen! My little cucumber.

string.name: cutscene.04Intro.MahavirWanders
string.value: Do not be angry because my heart wanders...

string.name: cutscene.04Intro.DeniseFlirt
string.value: Mahavir, I'm here to do my job, not flirt with you!

string.name: cutscene.04Intro.MahavirFlirt
string.value: But you don't understand. I am here to flirt with EVERYONE.

string.name: cutscene.04Intro.DeniseTimothy
string.value: Even Timothy?

string.name: cutscene.04Intro.MahavirBoundaries
string.value: The love of Mahavir knows no boundaries!

string.name: cutscene.04Intro.MahavirStroganoff
string.value: Except, well, I can't stand the smell of that stroganoff stuff. So no.

string.name: cutscene.04Intro.TimothyTrouble
string.value: Denise, you know we have to do our jobs, right? We're going to get in trouble with all this... slacking off!

string.name: cutscene.04Intro.DeniseIKnow
string.value: Oh, I know...

string.name: cutscene.04Intro.TimothyWhiteboard
string.value: Tara is always drawing... those comic-book pictures of hers on the company whiteboard.

string.name: cutscene.04Intro.TimothyWhiteboard2
string.value: Sure, it's fine for her to take a break and relax that way, but...

string.name: cutscene.04Intro.TimothyArt
string.value: Sometimes... sometimes she's not even at her desk to do those... terrifying... art tasks when they come in!

string.name: cutscene.04Intro.TimothyLoafing
string.value: And Mahavir... Mahavir! Always loafing around! Augh!! Augh, Augh!

string.name: cutscene.04Intro.TimothyWork
string.value: You've got to get him to do some work today! I can't take it anymore!

string.name: cutscene.04Intro.TaraWow
string.value: Wow. Good luck getting Mahavir to work...

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.DeniseJunk
string.value: All right, now to get some of this confetti cleaned up...

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.WinstonProductive
string.value: How productive.

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.DeniseEarly
string.value: I didn't expect anyone to be here so early.

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.WinstonGrunts
string.value: Yes. I let myself in... to get some things done before the grunts show up.

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.DeniseEmployees
string.value: Uh... are you one of the employees here?

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.WinstonSortOf
string.value: Sort of.

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.DeniseDenise
string.value: Well... I'm Denise. The new office manager.

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.WinstonSystem
string.value: Yes, I know. In fact, I knew all about it as soon as you were hired, so I could set you up in the system.

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.DeniseSystem
string.value: The system?

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.WinstonQuestions
string.value: Maybe we should get all your questions out of the way so I can get back to work.

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.DeniseSorry
string.value: Oh, I'm sorry, I didn't mean to...!

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.WinstonWinston
string.value: I'm Winston.

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.WinstonInformation
string.value: I handle a lot of the information infrastructure and service deployment across multiple locations for C.A.I.

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.DeniseComputers
string.value: Does... that have something to do with computers?

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.WinstonNickname
string.value: Yes, computers. I think Mahavir calls me 'the tech whiz.' An appropriate enough nickname, I suppose.

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.DeniseTechnical
string.value: Oh, very nice to meet you! Let me guess, you specialize in technical tasks?

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.WinstonImportant
string.value: Yes, in fact it's very important that you give those to me.

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.WinstonNetworks
string.value: I can't always be here to keep an eye on things. I'm in high demand in the other offices. But I'd rather not have other people mucking around with my networks!

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.TimothyKnewIt
string.value: I knew it! I knew it!

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.TimothyIncompetent
string.value: You... you think we're all incompetent, don't you!

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.WinstonCripes
string.value: Oh cripes, Timothy... now look...

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.TimothyTechnical
string.value: I'll have you know I handle a lot of the technical tasks when you're not around, Winston!

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.TimothyDegree
string.value: I may not have a fancy engineering degree like you, but I'm not an idiot!

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.WinstonNeverSaid
string.value: I never said...

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.TimothyWork
string.value: Do you know how hard I work?

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.TimothyFinancial
string.value: All the financial tasks, everything Mahavir slacks off on... hah... hah...

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.DenisePlease
string.value: Oh no, Timothy, please...

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.TimothyDammit
string.value: I'm a competent, loyal, hard-working employee, dammit!

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.MahavirKnot
string.value: What's got his suspenders in a knot this time?

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.WinstonXanax
string.value: Inferiority complex? Forgot to take his Xanax?

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.MahavirWinston
string.value: Oh, hey, Winston. Got bored of the downtown office finally?

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.WinstonRouter
string.value: Well, I had to come over here to upgrade the firewall software...

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.MahavirSure
string.value: Yeah, suuure.

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.MahavirBack
string.value: I know why you went over there and I can guess why you're back!

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.MahavirAccounting
string.value: I bet you finally figured out that new girl from human resources you were flirting with is...

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.WinstonWorkToDo
string.value: I have work to do!

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.MahavirLesbian
string.value: ...a lover of the lay-dies! A suitor of the sapphic sweeties! You had no idea! Oh, you're so predictable!

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.WinstonPrefer
string.value: ...and this is why I prefer not to talk to anyone while I'm working.

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.DeniseUnderstand
string.value: I think I'm starting to understand how you feel!

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.TimothyHelp
string.value: Denise, you've got to help me. I can do those technical tasks, I swear I can!

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.DeniseKnows
string.value: Well I know, but you don't need to--

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.TimothyProveIt
string.value: I'll prove it, I'll do a whole bunch of them... Yeah! A bunch!

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.TimothyNeedBooks
string.value: Just... Just get me one of those technical manuals! You can get them at OfficeTown!

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.HelpBookExplain
string.value: You can buy manuals at OfficeTown that will temporarily improve an employee's skills.

string.name: cutscene.05Intro.HelpBookExplain2
string.value: They only last one day, and they're kind of pricey, so use them wisely!

string.name: cutscene.05Outro.WinstonCrew
string.value: All right, crew... I'm out of here.

string.name: cutscene.05Outro.MahavirDiscoNap
string.value: Time to go? Excellent! I really need to get home and disco nap before going out...

string.name: cutscene.05Outro.WinstonWarehouse
string.value: A disco? You nap enough for a rave. In a 50,000 square foot warehouse.

string.name: cutscene.05Outro.MahavirRave
string.value: Wait, you know where there's a rave?

string.name: cutscene.05Outro.MahavirWaitUp
string.value: Hey, wait up!

string.name: cutscene.05Outro.TaraEnjoying
string.value: Bye, Denise. Thanks, um... you're a nice office manager.

string.name: cutscene.05Outro.DeniseTara
string.value: Oh, Tara, no. Thank you, I...

string.name: cutscene.05Outro.TaraShining
string.value: Um, sorry. I have to go. Shining Beauty Warrior Himiko X is on in twenty minutes.

string.name: cutscene.05Outro.DeniseShining
string.value: Shining Beauty...

string.name: cutscene.05Outro.TaraHimiko
string.value: ...Warrior Himiko X.

string.name: cutscene.05Outro.DeniseFun
string.value: Right! Have fun!

string.name: cutscene.05Outro.DeniseAllRight
string.value: Are you all right?

string.name: cutscene.05Outro.TimothyTechnical
string.value: So.. so much work... technical... I can't...

string.name: cutscene.05Outro.DeniseOverdid
string.value: Oh, dear. You kind of overdid it today, huh? Do you, ah...

string.name: cutscene.05Outro.DeniseOverdid2
string.value: Need some more stroganoff... or something?

string.name: cutscene.05Outro.TimothyPressure
string.value: You don't understand! The pressure... the excruciating... head... pressure... the noises... the tasks... my head...

string.name: cutscene.05Outro.DeniseRelax
string.value: Timothy... you work so hard, but don't forget to relax, too!

string.name: cutscene.05Outro.DenisePromise
string.value: It's good to get work done, but you don't have to take your job so seriously! Everything will get done, I promise!

string.name: cutscene.05Outro.TimothySeriously
string.value: ...so seriously? My JOB?

string.name: cutscene.05Outro.DeniseTogether
string.value: Here, let me go shut down my computer and we'll walk out together.

string.name: cutscene.05Outro.TimothyJob
string.value: Not take my job...

string.name: cutscene.05Outro.TimothySeriously2
string.value: ...so seriously?

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.DeniseGuys
string.value: Guys... have you seen Timothy?

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.WinstonStroganasty
string.value: Is he in the kitchen eating that stroganasty stuff?

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.MahavirMorning
string.value: Augh! Don't make me think about that stench so early in the morning! I'm still nauseous from yesterday!

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.DeniseNow
string.value: No... he's usually here by now!

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.TimothyDudes
string.value: Hey, dudes and dudettes! What's up?

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.MahavirTimothy
string.value: What did he just say?

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.MahavirThatYou
string.value: Timothy? Is that you, or just someone that looks suspiciously like you?

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.TimothyNap
string.value: Yeah, what's wrong? Did you just wake up from another NAP or something?

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.TimothyKill
string.value: Hah, I kill me!

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.WinstonTasks
string.value: Right. I've got some tasks to get on.

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.TimothySquares
string.value: Tasks! That stuff is for squares. You take your job way too seriously!

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.WinstonWonder
string.value: OK, now I'm starting to wonder who you are too.

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.WinstonReplace
string.value: Did you replace Timothy?

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.WinstonBeamDown
string.value: Are the rest of the body-snatchers going to beam down soon?

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.MahavirOverlords
string.value: I, for one, welcome our new slack-happy alien overlords.

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.TimothyOutlook
string.value: Nah, you wiseguys! I just have a new outlook on life - thanks to Denise!

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.DeniseThanksToMe
string.value: What? Thanks to me?

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.TimothyKitchen
string.value: I'll be hanging out in the kitchen, kemosabes.

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.TimothyWork
string.value: Call me if there's any work...

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.TimothyDont
string.value: ...no, wait a second, don't! Winston! You do all the work. You're the know-it-all.

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.TimothyRecipe
string.value: I have more important things to think about, like my new stroganoff recipe!

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.WinstonToday
string.value: It doesn't sound like he'll be doing much today. Other than smelling up this whole side of the office.

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.DeniseBreak
string.value: I think he could use a break!

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.DeniseMahavir
string.value: Mahavir, you can handle his financial tasks pretty well, right?

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.MahavirCucumber
string.value: For you, my little cucumber, anything...

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.MahavirExcept
string.value: ...except that!

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.DeniseWhat
string.value: What? Why not?

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.MahavirRave
string.value: I was out all night at that rave Winston told me about. I need to get some rest!

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.WinstonDegenerate
string.value: I didn't tell you about any rave, you degenerate!

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.MahavirText
string.value: That text message wasn't from you?

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.WinstonRaves
string.value: I don't go to raves!!!

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.DeniseManage
string.value: Well... we'll manage somehow, I'm sure.

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.DeniseRightTara
string.value: Right, Tara?

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.TaraHimiko
string.value: I'm almost done with this portrait of Eternal Lunar Himiko. Don't let anyone near the whiteboard.

string.name: cutscene.06Intro.DeniseSomehow
string.value: Yeah... we'll manage somehow.

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.WinstonDifferent
string.value: So uh... what exactly did you tell Timothy, anyway? He's been acting totally different.

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.DeniseKnow
string.value: Oh gosh, I really don't even know!

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.DeniseSeriously
string.value: Unless it was just me saying that he didn't have to take his job so seriously!

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.WinstonPillar
string.value: You probably knocked out the last crumbling pillar of his work-obsessed worldview.

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.DeniseDid
string.value: I... I did?

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.DeniseOK
string.value: Is he going to be OK?

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.WinstonGood
string.value: Probably good for him in the long run.

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.TimothyStroganoff
string.value: I don't see why I can't just spend all my time making stroganoff...

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.MahavirHazard
string.value: Because it would be a health hazard?

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.MahavirCardboard
string.value: Because that stuff looks like cardboard paste smeared on some chewed-up strips of cardboard in cardboard gravy?

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.TimothyWhatever
string.value: Whatever, dude...

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.TimothyDenise
string.value: Hey Denise, I've been meaning to tell you.

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.DeniseYesTim
string.value: Yes, Timothy?

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.DeniseFeeling
string.value: How are you feeling?

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.TimothyGreat
string.value: Not so great.

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.TimothyJoint
string.value: I'm kind of tired of this joint, you dig?

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.DeniseDig
string.value: Uh... I think I might... dig?

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.TimothyRealized
string.value: I realized you're right. I don't need this job.

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.TimothyDont
string.value: I don't need...

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.TimothyStinking
string.value: this stinking...

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.TimothySorry
string.value: Sorry about that.

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.TimothyResigning
string.value: What I meant to say is, I'll be resigning.

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.DeniseProud
string.value: Well, I'm very proud of you, Timothy.

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.WinstonProud
string.value: That's a first. You're proud of him?

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.DeniseYes
string.value: Well, yes.

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.DenisePursue
string.value: You've obviously been thinking about your feelings toward your work here, and I guess you've decided you don't want to be here any more...

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.DeniseAnyway
string.value: What exactly are you going to do next, anyway?

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.TimothyAccountant
string.value: Oh, I know all of you think I'm just a mild-mannered accountant.

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.TimothyDreams
string.value: But I assure you, I have dreams!

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.TimothyAmbitions
string.value: I have ambitions!

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.TimothyPlans
string.value: I have plans!

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.TimothyNotSoMuch
string.value: Well, not so much plans yet, but I'll make some plans.

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.TimothyOneThing
string.value: I don't know what they'll be, but one thing is for sure...

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.TimothyStroganoff2
string.value: They will involve stroganoff.

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.TimothyAmigos
string.value: Hasta la fuego, amigos!

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.TaraFire
string.value: Uh... Did he just say... until the fire?

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.WinstonLuego
string.value: I think he meant hasta luego.

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.WinstonNotSure
string.value: But who knows with that guy...

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.WinstonFinancial
string.value: I hope you like financial tasks, Mahavir.

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.WinstonPearl
string.value: And I hope you can explain all this to the management... and Pearl.

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.WinstonYoullSee
string.value: Oh, you'll see.

string.name: cutscene.06Outro.WinstonYoullSee2
string.value: You'll see soooooon enough.

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.DeniseLast
string.value: Phew, I think that's the last of it!

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.WinstonDifferent
string.value: This place looks completely different than it did at the beginning of the year.

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.DeniseWinston
string.value: Oh, Winston, you're back!

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.WinstonCheck
string.value: I thought I should come by and check on things.

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.WinstonCarpets
string.value: When did you find time to repaint and clean the carpets?

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.DeniseYouKnow
string.value: Oh, you know...

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.DeniseWeekends
string.value: I had some free weekends.

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.DeniseTidy
string.value: Not much to do besides water my plants and come in here to tidy up a bit!

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.WinstonHappyAC
string.value: Whoa, you even got the air conditioner back from the repair shop!

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.WinstonHappyAC2
string.value: That's great, it needs to be kept on as much as possible so that the desktop CPUs stay optimally chilly!

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.DeniseAC
string.value: If you say so...! I was just thinking it might be a warm spring this year...

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.ACInstruction
string.value: The air conditioner affects the whole office. Some employees like it on, but others don't!

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.ACInstruction2
string.value: Send any employee to the air conditioner to switch it on or off.

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.PearlChildren
string.value: Hellloooo children, I'm hooome!

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.PearlTrouble
string.value: Back from my Scandinavian cruise, and I hope you haven't been getting in trouble!

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.WinstonWrongDay
string.value: Oh, God. I picked the wrong day to come back here.

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.DeniseConkling
string.value: Hello, ma'am! Welcome to C.A.I. Can I help you?

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.PearlWhat
string.value: What? Who on earth are you, miss...?

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.MahavirYoureBack
string.value: You're back!

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.MahavirSouveniers
string.value: Wheee, did you bring me any souvenirs?

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.PearlFjords
string.value: No, dear boy, but I do have some lovely photographs of the fjords. I'll be sure to show you later.

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.PearlIntern
string.value: Now, who do we have here? A new intern? She doesn't look too promising.

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.PearlFacsimile
string.value: Do you know how to operate a facsimile machine?

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.DeniseActually
string.value: Well actually, I...

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.PearlTechnology
string.value: That's all right, dear. Technology is not everyone's forte.

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.PearlWinston
string.value: And Winston is here, he can send the faxes. So good with machines, that boy.

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.WinstonWhat
string.value: What? I have better things to do than send faxes!

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.TaraManager
string.value: She's actually the new office manager.

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.PearlISee
string.value: I see.

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.PearlTaxing
string.value: Well, I don't know what management could have been thinking to thrust a young girl like you into such a taxing position.

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.PearlExperience
string.value: It really should have gone to someone with more experience, and I'm sorry you've had to deal with it, dear!

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.DeniseManaged
string.value: Oh, no, that's all right, I've managed to...

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.PearlSuitable
string.value: No no, don't worry. I'm sure we can get all these administrative mistakes sorted out soon, and find a position more suitable for you.

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.PearlDecisions
string.value: In the meantime, I can help you make the right decisions.

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.DeniseButI
string.value: But I...

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.PearlAssure
string.value: It's really no problem, I assure you!

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.PearlDebra
string.value: Auntie Pearl will take care of everything, Debra. She always does!

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.DeniseItsDenise
string.value: It's Denise, not Debra!

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.PearlSure
string.value: I'm sure it is.

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.PearlSuppose
string.value: I suppose you were the one who's done all this... this...

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.DeniseCouch
string.value: Yes, I've just finished patching up the back of the couch, and...

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.PearlVeryWell
string.value: Very well.

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.PearlACUnhappy
string.value: And I see you've turned the air conditioning on as well. How wasteful! I'm shivering already! Will someone please turn that off?

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.PearlTimothy
string.value: Where's Timothy? I can't imagine he was too happy about all this... change.

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.MahavirQuit
string.value: Oh, he quit!

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.PearlWhat2
string.value: What?! What on earth do you--

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.PearlWellINever
string.value: Well, I never!

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.DeniseHappier
string.value: He seemed happy about it, really!

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.PearlChaos
string.value: I don't know what you've been muddling in around here, Little Miss Chaos, but don't worry, I'm here to help.

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.PearlFinancial
string.value: You can give me all the financial tasks until we find a replacement for Timothy.

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.WinstonMahavir
string.value: Well, since he left, Mahavir's been...

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.MahavirSilence
string.value: I've been waaaaay too busy and overworked!

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.MahavirBookkeeping
string.value: It's true, Pearl, we really need help with the bookkeeping, it's a mess!

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.PearlWorking
string.value: Oh, poor boy, you've been working so hard while everyone's been away!

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.PearlCouch
string.value: Go rest on the couch, you deserve a break.

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.MahavirDontTellTwice
string.value: OK! You don't need to tell me that twice!

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.PearlNeedBooks
string.value: Debra, I'll need you to fetch me some financial help books, there's a dear. Make yourself useful!

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.PearlNeedKitchen
string.value: And I hope my private popcorn supply is still in the kitchen cabinets! I've been craving popcorn since Reykjavik...

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.DeniseNameNot
string.value: But my name's not... Debra...

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.DeniseForReal
string.value: Is she for real, Winston?

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.WinstonBrick
string.value: Real like a brick wall, baby.

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.WinstonForty
string.value: She's been in this company for forty years, knows how to do everything, and thinks she knows how everyone else should be doing everything, too.

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.WinstonPearlStress
string.value: She goes ballistic when any of us are doing anything besides working... except for Mahavir, but that's a long story.

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.WinstonPearlStress2
string.value: Sometimes she gets so worked up that she can't do anything but relax by popping popcorn.

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.DeniseExperience
string.value: Well, I'm sure her experience will... come in handy?

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.WinstonYourJob
string.value: Oh, sure. Handy for running all over the rest of us. Just don't let her steal your job.

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.WinstonWanted
string.value: After all, she's wanted it for years.

string.name: cutscene.07Intro.DeniseOhMy
string.value: Oh, my...

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.DeniseOhDear
string.value: Oh dear...

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.DeniseSecond
string.value: Winston, do you have a second?

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.WinstonProject
string.value: You've already used up three seconds. I'm busy with this project.

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.DeniseVideo
string.value: Is that a video game machine?

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.WinstonDistract
string.value: I need something to distract me from Pearl's constant nagging while I'm over here.

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.WinstonOffices
string.value: I already installed them in all the other offices. Strictly for stress-reduction purposes, you know.

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.DeniseFine
string.value: Oh... yes, I'm sure that's fine.

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.DenisePurpleTasks
string.value: Um... what do I do with purple tasks?

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.PearlSilly
string.value: Silly girl! I suppose you can't be expected to know such things. It's a writing task.

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.DeniseISee
string.value: Oh, I see...

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.DeniseWriting
string.value: Who does the writing?

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.PearlStaff
string.value: Well, we don't have a writer right now, but we can certainly make do with our staff.

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.DeniseMainOffice
string.value: But the central office called and asked if we could handle two batches of purple tasks, and I said...

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.PearlWhat
string.value: What? You told them yes?!

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.WinstonHooBoy
string.value: Hoo boy.

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.DeniseTwoBatches
string.value: Well, it's only two batches, right?

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.PearlDozens
string.value: Two batches is dozens and dozens of tasks, child! And we're still short one employee.

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.MahavirNoWay
string.value: Plus, there's no way I can do that kind of task.

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.MahavirStand
string.value: It's my least favorite, really can't stand them.

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.DeniseArt
string.value: But I thought art tasks were your least favorite?

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.MahavirBoth
string.value: They're both my least favorite!

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.MahavirFinancial
string.value: And you know how I feel about financial tasks, so...

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.DeniseTechnical
string.value: Then that must mean you like technical tasks, right?

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.MahavirWinston
string.value: Oh sure, but Winston would get mad if I did those.

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.MahavirBuddy
string.value: Right, buddy?

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.WinstonLeaveMeOut
string.value: Leave me out of this!

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.PearlFlirting
string.value: Stop flirting, you two!

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.PearlUnseemly
string.value: It's unseemly, and we have work to do...

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.PearlTara
string.value: Tara! Come over here. Chop chop, move those little legs!

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.TaraUm
string.value: Um... I have some... stuff to do...

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.PearlBite
string.value: Oh child, I'm not going to bite you! You're a creative type, right?

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.PearlWriting
string.value: That's why we hired you. So surely you can handle some writing too.

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.TaraMostly
string.value: But I... I mostly draw...

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.PearlSkillset
string.value: Hm. Your skill sets could use some expanding.

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.PearlCoddling
string.value: Denise, give the writing tasks to Tara. I'll help her out if she can't handle it all, but there's no use in coddling everyone.

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.MahavirCoddled
string.value: I could use a healthy dose of coddling!

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.TaraMahavir
string.value: But Mahavir... He could do it better than...

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.TaraNeverMind
string.value: Oh, never mind.

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.PearlRidiculous
string.value: Don't be ridiculous. English isn't even Mahavir's first language! You can't expect him to write in it.

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.DenisePerfectly
string.value: What? He speaks English perfectly!

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.WinstonHarvard
string.value: That's probably because he has a graduate degree in English Literature from Harvard!!

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.MahavirPardons
string.value: No no, very sorry Miss, my English not so good, many pardons.

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.PearlArguing
string.value: We're not going to waste valuable company time arguing about this.

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.PearlMarketable
string.value: Tara, you'll learn a new marketable skill.

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.TaraMarket
string.value: But I don't want to... market...

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.PearlKitten
string.value: Denise, take care of that task, don't just stand there like a wet kitten!

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.PearlCouch
string.value: Mahavir... go relax on the couch dear, it will all be fine. Don't let these boorish rubes make fun of your English abilities.

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.PearlDesk
string.value: I'll be at my desk if you need me. Oh, and Winston!

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.WinstonAnnoyed
string.value: What?! Can't you see I'm trying to work?

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.PearlUpgrades
string.value: We need to have a little chat at the water cooler! You haven't briefed me on the hardware upgrades.

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.WinstonAnnoyed2
string.value: Briefed you?! Do you really need to know about... Oh, fine, whatever!

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.TaraDrawing
string.value: I just wanted to finish my new drawing today...

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.MahavirTasks
string.value: Look, don't give Tara all the writing tasks. She'll wilt, like the delicate flower she is!

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.DeniseSome
string.value: So I can give you some?

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.MahavirOne
string.value: Well, maybe one. Just one. And don't tell anyone else I said that, I have a reputation to preserve!

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.DeniseCoddling
string.value: Honestly, that woman shouldn't be talking about coddling, all she tells you to do is sit on the couch!

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.MahavirRest
string.value: I need rest to fulfill my most important duty!

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.DeniseWhichIs
string.value: Which is...?

string.name: cutscene.08Intro.MahavirPresence
string.value: Beautifying this drab workplace with my radiant presence, of course!

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.PearlHonestly
string.value: Honestly, I don't know how long you think you can get away with...

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.WinstonMothership
string.value: I'm sorry, I can't hear you. I have to destroy the mothership to complete the fifth wave.

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.PearlPolicies
string.value: That's exactly what I'm talking about! You think you don't need to follow office policies!

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.PearlPolicies2
string.value: You come and go as you please, playing this... noisy ZAP thing!

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.WinstonHear
string.value: I can't heeear you!

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.DeniseTour
string.value: And that's the tour of the office! Thanks so much for agreeing to help out, Luke!

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.LukeSure
string.value: Sure thing...

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.LukeChill
string.value: This place looks pretty chill. I like it. It's got this... vibe, or something.

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.DeniseFun
string.value: Yes, there are a lot of fun things to do around here, aren't there?

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.DeniseWork
string.value: We just have to make sure all the work gets done too!

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.LukeRightOn
string.value: Right on, I know what you mean. Gotta keep the man off your back.

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.LukeConditioner
string.value: Hey, you guys don't keep this air conditioner on all the time, do you? Maybe that vibe was like, electricity being wasted...

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.DeniseWarmer
string.value: Oh! Well, we have been turning it on more often now that the weather's warmer. Besides, the tasks stick together when it's humid!

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.MahavirCurly
string.value: And my hair becomes positively unmanageable!!

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.LukeBad
string.value: But that like, conditioned air is bad for you, y'know?

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.LukeFreon
string.value: All that freon, messing with the balance of freon radicals in your bloodstream...

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.DeniseOK
string.value: Oh... sure, OK!

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.DeniseMuch
string.value: We don't have to leave it on that much...

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.PearlGoofing
string.value: All of you are just goofing off!

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.PearlGetTo
string.value: Get to work!

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.PearlTara
string.value: Especially you, Tara - you have a lot of writing to do, and no time to be... DOODLING like that.

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.DeniseSolution
string.value: Oh, Pearl! Don't worry about the writing tasks, I've found a solution!

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.DeniseLuke
string.value: This is Luke, he's a freelance writer.

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.LukeHowdy
string.value: Howdy, ma'am. Beautiful name you've got there, so... organic!

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.LukeHowdy2
string.value: Nice to be aboard, and my pen's at yer service.

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.PearlFreelancer
string.value: You hired a freelancer?

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.PearlPermission
string.value: Did you get permission for that?

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.DeniseContacted
string.value: Well, I contacted...

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.PearlPaperwork
string.value: Did you fill out the proper paperwork?

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.PearlAuthorization
string.value: You need an authorization Z1-84B...

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.DeniseSlip
string.value: Z1-84B86-A with a K180 notification slip, right?

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.PearlRight
string.value: Why... yes, that's right.

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.DeniseApproved
string.value: All taken care of! The central office approved it yesterday.

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.TaraWriting
string.value: So... so I don't have to do all that writing anymore?

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.LukeLeave
string.value: Leave it to Luke, lil' lady. I'll show y'all what I'm made of... all natural!

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.LukeWatercooler
string.value: Don't mind if I use your water jug there, do ya?

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.LukeWatercooler2
string.value: I need to fix myself some of my homemade herbal tea... Nothin's more relaxing!

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.DeniseOKWatercooler
string.value: Uh... sure Luke, go right ahead!

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.WinstonNotBad
string.value: Well all right, then. Not bad, Denise.

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.DeniseNoProblem
string.value: No problem!

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.PearlHmph
string.value: Hmph.

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.PearlLollygagging
string.value: There's still far too much lollygagging and lackadaising around here.

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.DeniseWorry
string.value: No need to worry Pearl, we can get everything...

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.PearlWorry
string.value: Don't tell me not to worry, missy!

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.TaraYesMaam
string.value: Um... yes, ma'am?

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.PearlWatercooler
string.value: Report to me at the water cooler when you have a chance!

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.PearlDiscuss
string.value: There are some important matters I need to discuss with you, about your future at C.A.I.!

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.TaraAllRight
string.value: All... all right...

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.MahavirMiss
string.value: Huh, what? Man, what a weird dream... did I miss anything?

string.name: cutscene.09Intro.WinstonChange
string.value: Only things starting to change around here...

string.name: cutscene.09Outro.PearlUnderstand
string.value: So I hope you understand now.

string.name: cutscene.09Outro.PearlDoodles
string.value: Some people might consider drawing doodles and playing with art programs all day to be work. But I do not!

string.name: cutscene.09Outro.PearlSkills
string.value: And I really think you ought to continue development of your other skills.

string.name: cutscene.09Outro.TaraYesMaam
string.value: Yes, ma'am.

string.name: cutscene.09Outro.PearlSpreadsheets
string.value: Now I want you to go out and buy some financial software - something like MegaChart or FormulaMaster - and practice working with spreadsheets, too.

string.name: cutscene.09Outro.PearlHorizons
string.value: Have fun! Explore new horizons!

string.name: cutscene.09Outro.DeniseSpreadsheets
string.value: She's making you do spreadsheets now too?

string.name: cutscene.09Outro.TaraItsLike
string.value: It's like...

string.name: cutscene.09Outro.TaraItsLike2
string.value: It's like...

string.name: cutscene.09Outro.TaraMalvia
string.value: It's like I'm trapped in the Dimension of Darkness with Demon Queen Malvia!

string.name: cutscene.09Outro.DeniseThatBad
string.value: Oh... uh... that bad, really?

string.name: cutscene.09Outro.TaraFlowerKick
string.value: I don't even know how to do a Super Himiko Flower Transformation Kick!

string.name: cutscene.09Outro.DeniseHoney
string.value: Oh honey, you don't need to... um, practice martial arts, or whatever!

string.name: cutscene.09Outro.TaraUnderstand
string.value: You don't understand!

string.name: cutscene.09Outro.WinstonWorries
string.value: That kid worries me.

string.name: cutscene.09Outro.WinstonWorld
string.value: Always off in her own world.

string.name: cutscene.09Outro.DeniseDimension
string.value: And this dimension...

string.name: cutscene.09Outro.DeniseOffice
string.value: I mean, this office, doesn't seem to be particularly friendly to her.

string.name: cutscene.09Outro.WinstonPearl
string.value: Well, not Demon Queen Pearl, at any rate.

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.PearlWinston
string.value: Oh Winston!

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.PearlDear
string.value: Winston, dear!

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.PearlDiscuss
string.value: I have something very exciting to discuss with you!

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.WinstonSound
string.value: Why do I not like the sound of that?

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.PearlLaughs
string.value: Hee hee hee!

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.PearlInterrupt
string.value: Don't let me interrupt your videogame, dear.

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.WinstonGameOver
string.value: It was game over as soon as I heard that tone of glee in your voice.

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.PearlHonestly
string.value: Whatever on earth could you be talking about? Honestly.

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.PearlPolicies
string.value: I was just coming over to tell you about some new policies relating to network maintenance and... ahem...

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.PearlUnauthorized
string.value: Unauthorized computer equipment in the office.

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.PearlManual
string.value: The central office has just sent over a new manual full of regulations. At my request, of course.

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.WinstonTime
string.value: Look, I really don't have time to...

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.PearlOfCourse
string.value: Oh no, no, of course not.

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.PearlGames
string.value: You obviously have so many games to play.

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.PearlFret
string.value: No need to fret!

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.PearlDetails
string.value: I can give you the details, which I'm sure you'll need to know in order to avoid breaking the rules.

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.PearlTrouble
string.value: You wouldn't want to get in trouble, would you?

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.WinstonSuppose
string.value: I suppose not.

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.PearlPopcorn
string.value: I'll just be in the kitchen making popcorn. Let me know when you're ready and we'll have a little water cooler chat.

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.WinstonLevel27
string.value: Looks like I'm not going to beat level 27 anytime soon.

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.WinstonPopcorn
string.value: I hope she chokes on a kernel of her beloved popcorn.

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.MahavirOuch
string.value: Ouch!

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.MahavirBitter
string.value: So bitter, my friend.

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.MahavirLadies
string.value: The ladies do not find that attractive!

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.WinstonPlayer
string.value: Unlike you, being the number one player in the company is not my life's goal.

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.MahavirBetter
string.value: All the better for me!

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.MahavirLuke
string.value: Say, what do you think of this new guy, Luke?

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.WinstonAllRight
string.value: Seems all right.

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.LukeFeel
string.value: Ohhhh... I still don't feel so good.

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.MahavirThird
string.value: That's the third time today he's been in there.

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.DeniseLuke
string.value: Luke's not feeling well?

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.MahavirHealth
string.value: He's certainly not what I would call 'in good health.'

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.DeniseOhDear
string.value: Oh, dear.

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.WinstonFriend
string.value: How do you know that guy anyway? Is he a friend of yours?

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.DeniseCollege
string.value: Well yes, sort of. He's my college roommate's friend.

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.MahavirFriend
string.value: So he's a friend of a friend.

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.DeniseNeighbor
string.value: Well technically, he's her friend's brother's ex-girlfriend's next-door neighbor.

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.DeniseKnow
string.value: I don't know that much about him.

string.value: What year is it?

string.name: cutscene.10Intro.LukeYear2
string.value: What year?

string.value: It's 2007, dude.

string.value: That must be it.

string.value: Or six.
