string.value: Oh, I remember. You're the one who sleeps instead of getting any work done at all.

string.name: cutscene.21Intro.MahavirCapable
string.value: Oh, but I am capable of so much more.

string.name: cutscene.21Intro.MahavirBreeding
string.value: Why, now that we have a lady of your... obvious breeding and refinement in the office, I was thinking we might...

string.name: cutscene.21Intro.NadineEarth
string.value: Not if you were the last man on earth. I'd still be able to do better.

string.name: cutscene.21Intro.MahavirRapier
string.value: Ah, your rapier wit is...

string.name: cutscene.21Intro.NadineConversation
string.value: This conversation is over.

string.name: cutscene.21Intro.NadineSmell
string.value: And furthermore... what on earth is that ungodly smell?

string.name: cutscene.21Intro.LukeDudes
string.value: Hey, dudes.

string.name: cutscene.21Intro.NadineAugh
string.value: Augh! Is that you?

string.name: cutscene.21Intro.NadineDousing
string.value: What have you been bathing in? Skunks?

string.name: cutscene.21Intro.LukeMedicinal
string.value: I don't know what you're talking about, man! Everything I put in my body is all-natural and for medicinal purposes.

string.name: cutscene.21Intro.NadineBiohazard
string.value: Just stay away from me, you walking biohazard!

string.name: cutscene.21Intro.NadineSlacker
string.value: As for you, Mahawhatever... get back to work, slacker.

string.name: cutscene.21Intro.NadineBarge
string.value: And don't hit on me again, or the next time you wake up on your couch, it'll be on a garbage barge in the South Pacific.

string.name: cutscene.21Intro.MahavirRejection
string.value: Ach! The crushing agony of rejection! How sad...

string.name: cutscene.21Intro.MahavirPollens
string.value: Sad that she seems to be allergic to the most noble of pollens... the Charm of Mahavir!

string.name: cutscene.21Intro.MahavirCharms
string.value: There is but one cure... I must acclimatize her to my charms.

string.name: cutscene.21Intro.LukeMellow
string.value: You need to mellow out, man.

string.name: cutscene.21Intro.LukeProblems
string.value: I've discovered just the thing, takes care of so many stress-related problems...

string.name: cutscene.21Intro.MahavirTrouble
string.value: That's OK, man. I have enough trouble keeping my eyes open as it is!

string.name: cutscene.22Intro.PearlClout
string.value: Now just calm down, I don't have enough clout yet to fire him.

string.name: cutscene.22Intro.NadineCare
string.value: I don't care! It's either him or me, Pearl.

string.name: cutscene.22Intro.NadineProfessional
string.value: I am a professional expositor of poetic prose, while he is just a no-talent beatnik.

string.name: cutscene.22Intro.NadineStand
string.value: I can't stand being around... around people like that!

string.name: cutscene.22Intro.NadineIllegal
string.value: He smells, and I'm sure he's got something illegal on him.

string.name: cutscene.22Intro.PearlEvidence
string.value: Well, you don't have any evidence, do you?

string.name: cutscene.22Intro.NadineEvidence
string.value: How should I know anything about evidence? I'm not some... lowlife!

string.name: cutscene.22Intro.PearlProductive
string.value: In any case, he's not what I would call a productive employee.

string.name: cutscene.22Intro.PearlSecure
string.value: But we can't just fire him... that little girl made sure to get him a very secure position!

string.name: cutscene.22Intro.NadineSmarter
string.value: She's smarter than she looks.

string.name: cutscene.22Intro.PearlWellSee
string.value: We'll see about that.

string.name: cutscene.22Intro.PearlDenise
string.value: Oh Denise!

string.name: cutscene.22Intro.DenisePearl
string.value: Oh, hi, Pearl. What's up?

string.name: cutscene.22Intro.PearlUnderproductive
string.value: I've been noticing that Luke seems a bit... underproductive lately.

string.name: cutscene.22Intro.DeniseMellow
string.value: Really? He has seemed more relaxed and mellow lately.

string.name: cutscene.22Intro.DeniseParty
string.value: Ever since I told him to go to that party, actually..

string.name: cutscene.22Intro.PearlGoodness
string.value: Goodness. You really ought to restrict your advice-giving to workplace matters, don't you think?

string.name: cutscene.22Intro.PearlSluggish
string.value: But there's no doubt about it, he's sluggish.

string.name: cutscene.22Intro.DeniseHealth
string.value: Well, his health is not that great at times, but he's very good at getting writing tasks done!

string.name: cutscene.22Intro.PearlProof
string.value: Are you sure about that? I think we may need to see some proof of this performance.

string.name: cutscene.22Intro.PearlQualified
string.value: After all, he is a relatively new addition to the team, and nobody... qualified... was involved in his hiring.

string.name: cutscene.22Intro.DeniseHard
string.value: You'll see, he can work just as hard as anyone here!

string.name: cutscene.22Intro.DeniseGosh
string.value: Oh, gosh, what have I done now?

string.name: cutscene.22Intro.PearlWatch
string.value: Now we just sit back and watch.

string.name: cutscene.22Intro.PearlPriorities
string.value: She'll give him plenty of tasks, and if I'm guessing right, he has other priorities.

string.name: cutscene.22Intro.NadineBrownies
string.value: All he does is drink that rancid-smelling tea of his all day.

string.name: cutscene.22Intro.PearlMeddle
string.value: Oh, who am I kidding? I can't just watch, I want to meddle some more.

string.name: cutscene.22Intro.PearlLuke
string.value: Oh, Luke...

string.name: cutscene.22Outro.LukeTooMuch
string.value: I don't know what to tell you, dude. It's just been too much for me lately.

string.name: cutscene.22Outro.DeniseTasks
string.value: Is this about all those tasks I gave you?

string.name: cutscene.22Outro.DeniseBecause
string.value: Because... because...

string.name: cutscene.22Outro.LukeFret
string.value: Hey, little lady, don't fret! It's not you.

string.name: cutscene.22Outro.LukeHarpies
string.value: It's mostly those other two harpies.

string.name: cutscene.22Outro.LukeFeeling
string.value: I get the feeling they want me gone!

string.name: cutscene.22Outro.DeniseButLuke
string.value: But Luke, I...

string.name: cutscene.22Outro.DeniseFavor
string.value: You were so good to come in here and help out when I needed a favor, and...

string.name: cutscene.22Outro.LukeKindaFun
string.value: I know, and it was kinda fun for a while!

string.name: cutscene.22Outro.LukeDuncan
string.value: Even that crazy old bear Duncan.

string.name: cutscene.22Outro.LukeCutOut
string.value: But I don't think I'm cut out for the working world.

string.name: cutscene.22Outro.LukeJamaica
string.value: I'm gonna hit the road, go to Jamaica...

string.name: cutscene.22Outro.LukeAmsterdam
string.value: Check out Amsterdam...

string.name: cutscene.22Outro.LukeCafes
string.value: Hang out in some cafes...

string.name: cutscene.22Outro.LukeOhYeah
string.value: Huh? Oh, yeah.

string.name: cutscene.22Outro.LukeKick
string.value: So, they won't have me to kick around any more!

string.name: cutscene.22Outro.LukeBoots
string.value: These boots are made for walkin', and I'm sorry to see you go, but it's time to jump ship.

string.name: cutscene.22Outro.DeniseAnywhere
string.value: But I'm not going anywhere!

string.name: cutscene.22Outro.LukeYouKnow
string.value: Aww, you know what I mean.

string.name: cutscene.22Outro.LukeSweetheart
string.value: Anyway, the road's callin'. Take care, sweetheart.

string.name: cutscene.22Outro.MahavirWhat
string.value: What was that all about?

string.name: cutscene.22Outro.DeniseBest
string.value: Oh... I guess it's for the best.

string.name: cutscene.22Outro.DenisePicked
string.value: He wasn't happy here, being picked on.

string.name: cutscene.22Outro.MahavirWhoWould
string.value: Who would be?

string.name: cutscene.22Outro.MahavirAreYou
string.value: For that matter, are you?

string.name: cutscene.22Outro.DenisePearl
string.value: What do you mean... Pearl?

string.name: cutscene.22Outro.DeniseBossy
string.value: She's awfully bossy, but...

string.name: cutscene.22Outro.MahavirMean
string.value: She's downright mean and you know it!

string.name: cutscene.22Outro.DeniseRight
string.value: I guess you're right.

string.name: cutscene.22Outro.DeniseMood
string.value: One of these days I should talk with her and find out why she's in such a bad mood all the time!

string.name: cutscene.22Outro.MahavirTooNice
string.value: Sometimes I think she's a little too nice for this place!

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.DeniseProjections
string.value: I've been looking over the workload projections you made for Project PEARL for the upcoming week...

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.PearlHaveYouNow
string.value: Oh have you now?

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.DeniseLuke
string.value: Yes, and now that Luke's left I think we might need to...

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.PearlWorry
string.value: Oh, I'd say you have more important things to worry about.

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.PearlSnacks
string.value: I asked you to restrict the budget on those frivolous snacks!

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.DeniseSpending
string.value: But we did, we haven't been spending that much on...

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.PearlSneaking
string.value: I know you've been sneaking those diet sodas and brownies that you like!

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.DeniseButI
string.value: But I...

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.PearlNoMore
string.value: No more of that, missy!

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.PearlWatching
string.value: And don't think I won't be watching you.

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.MahavirCaught
string.value: I'm telling you, I definitely caught something from that Luke guy.

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.WinstonHypochondriac
string.value: Luke is a hypochondriac! The only thing you could catch from him is fleas.

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.MahavirImmune
string.value: This budget crunch on snacks has lowered my blood sugar.

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.MahavirCinnabun
string.value: Maybe a warm, tasty cinnabun will boost my immune system...

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.MahavirFeedACold
string.value: Wait a second, is it feed a cold or feed a fever?

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.WinstonSnack
string.value: I find it hard to believe that a sugary snack will cure what ails you.

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.MahavirNap
string.value: Then why do I feel so tired... like I need to take a nap?

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.WinstonNap
string.value: Oh yeah... I can't imagine ANY reason YOU might want to take a nap.

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.MahavirSyndrome
string.value: Maybe I have Chronic Fatigue Syndrome...

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.WinstonAcute
string.value: Yeah, and I have Acute Videogamitis.

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.WinstonScore
string.value: I might even be able to beat my high score at it today.

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.WinstonBangalore
string.value: Pearl's got some crazy scheme to outsource a lot of our technical tasks to Bangalore. It'll never work, but it means I don't have much to do.

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.PearlWinston
string.value: I heard that, Winston!

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.PearlSomething
string.value: Don't worry, we'll find SOMETHING for you to do around here!

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.WinstonPeace
string.value: Me and my big mouth... now I'll never get a moment of peace.

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.AshleyMen
string.value: Men! I can't believe them.

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.AshleyScum
string.value: All of them, they're all scum!

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.DeniseAshley
string.value: Oh, Ashley... Can I ask you for a favor?

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.AshleyBelieve
string.value: Can you believe those two?

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.AshleyOvergrown
string.value: They never want to work, they just want to play all day, like overgrown boys!

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.DeniseWho
string.value: Who... Mahavir and Winston?

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.AshleyBrad
string.value: Yes! They're even worse than Brad, Harris, and Pierce!

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.DeniseDated
string.value: Um... are these all guys you've dated recently?

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.AshleyTerrible
string.value: Augh! Don't remind me! This week has been terrible!

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.DeniseThisWeek
string.value: What, all of them this week?

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.AshleyCouple
string.value: Well, the last couple days.

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.AshleyThursday
string.value: I was really hungry on Thursday so I had dinner with Harris and then dinner with Pierce.

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.DeniseEat
string.value: Well, I guess a girl's gotta eat!

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.AshleyAtkins
string.value: I know! The Atkins diet makes me famished.

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.AshleySteaks
string.value: I could eat two or three steaks right now!

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.DeniseSnaks
string.value: Well, I wish I could offer you some snacks, but...

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.AshleyDeadbeats
string.value: Just keep those deadbeats working for a change! All of those... MEN.

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.AshleyTiffanys
string.value: They all claim to be investment bankers and lawyers, but none of them would buy me that new watch from Tiffany's I wanted!

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.AshleyAmex
string.value: Can you imagine? I had to phone Daddy to raise the limit on my AmEx.

string.name: cutscene.23Intro.DeniseHorror
string.value: Oh, the horror! The horror!

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.PearlOh
string.value: Oh! There you are, it's about time.

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.DeniseHead
string.value: Pearl, I called the head office again like you suggested, but...

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.PearlSuggest
string.value: What? I didn't suggest that!

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.PearlMisunderstood
string.value: You must have misunderstood.

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.DeniseConfusing
string.value: But... well... in any case, it was very confusing.

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.DeniseProject
string.value: They acted like they'd never heard of Project PEARL.

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.PearlWrong
string.value: Oh... well, you must have been talking to the wrong people.

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.PearlConnected
string.value: You're not as well-connected in C.A.I. as I am, of course.

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.PearlPriority
string.value: It's a high-priority project, and only high-priority personnel are, um... overseeing the stakeholder process!

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.DeniseRight
string.value: Right... that must be it.

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.PearlMatter
string.value: It doesn't matter!

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.PearlTimeLeft
string.value: We have to take care of Project PEARL here, there's not much time left!

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.DeniseBefore
string.value: Time left before what?

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.PearlDeadline
string.value: Before the deadline I've set for Project PEARL!

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.PearlBudget
string.value: Our budget is still a mess, and look at this... all of this!

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.DeniseAllOfWhat
string.value: All of what?

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.PearlEmployees
string.value: All these lazy, no-good employees, not doing anything!

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.DeniseNotTime
string.value: But it's not even time for work yet.

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.PearlExpect
string.value: Obviously I can't expect anyone else to care about this company but me.

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.PearlYourself
string.value: If you want something done right, do it yourself. At least if you're me!

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.PearlTasks
string.value: Denise, I'm going to need to take care of a lot of Project PEARL's tasks myself, at least for now!

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.PearlIdiots
string.value: Just keep these other idiots out of my hair!

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.DeniseHair
string.value: Out of your hair?

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.PearlSlacking
string.value: I don't want to hear any complaints, and you know how all this... slacking drives me crazy!

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.PearlCrazy
string.value: Just keep anyone from getting too crazy, including me, since I obviously am the only one who can get things done!

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.PearlFurthermore
string.value: And furthermore, I've put our budget problems to an end!

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.DeniseSnacks
string.value: Wow, really!? We can spend money on snacks again?

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.DeniseGlad
string.value: Everyone will be glad to hear that!

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.PearlHussy
string.value: No, you spendthrift hussy!

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.PearlManager
string.value: I've contacted the manager of OfficeTown and told him not to sell you any more food or drink at all, since obviously you can't control your spending enough.

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.DeniseNoSnacks
string.value: What?! No snacks at all?

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.PearlOwnGood
string.value: It's for your own good! All of you!

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.DeniseGetBy
string.value: But how... how are we supposed to get by without any snacks?

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.PearlYouFigure
string.value: I don't know! You figure it out!

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.PearlOfficeManager
string.value: You think you're such a good office manager, after all.

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.PearlInitiatives
string.value: Now, have Winston and Nadine standing by, I might need them to follow-up on some of my initiatives.

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.PearlSomeWork
string.value: At least they can get some work done occasionally!

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.PearlNiece
string.value: Ashley is predictably useless, just like all artists!

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.PearlMahavir
string.value: And Mahavir, well you know... his condition makes it hard for him to work.

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.DeniseCondition
string.value: His condition!? You really think he has Chronic Fatigue whatever?

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.PearlHush
string.value: Denise, hush!

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.PearlDisabilities
string.value: You shouldn't make light of employee's disabilities, unless you want C.A.I. dealing with a discrimination suit!

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.PearlCigarette
string.value: God! I need another cigarette.

string.name: cutscene.24Intro.PearlQuit
string.value: I can quit again right after this project is over!

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.DeniseUhPearl
string.value: Uh... Pearl?

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.DeniseWorst
string.value: I think we've gotten through the worst of it...

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.DeniseProject
string.value: We've done most of the work that we had to do for your project.

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.PearlWellSee
string.value: Well, we'll see about that!

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.DeniseExcuseMe
string.value: Excuse me?

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.DeniseMore
string.value: Is there more? I mean, I don't really get it.

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.PearlRuining
string.value: Of course you don't get it! This is my project, and you're ruining everything!

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.PearlMore
string.value: We've got to do it bigger, faster, better, more!

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.DenisePlan
string.value: But Pearl! How do you expect all of this work to get done when we don't even know what the plan is?

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.DeniseGoals
string.value: We don't even know what this project we're working on IS, or what our goals are!

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.DeniseTold
string.value: You haven't told me or anyone else anything except... except giving us all this work to do!

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.PearlLookMissy
string.value: Look, missy! Project PEARL is what I say it is! That's why it's called Project PEARL!

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.DeniseKnows
string.value: It's called that because you're the only one who knows anything about it, huh?

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.WinstonTrue
string.value: That's true in more ways than one.

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.WinstonCorporate
string.value: Nobody at Corporate approved this project, you just made it up.

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.WinstonAsking
string.value: I did some asking around. Project PEARL doesn't even exist.

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.PearlExists
string.value: Of course it exists!

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.PearlVision
string.value: It's in my heart, my soul, my vision...

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.MahavirDesk
string.value: It's all over my desk.

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.WinstonSpace
string.value: It's taking up half of our available hard drive space.

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.DeniseSupposed
string.value: And... you're telling me this isn't even something we were supposed to be doing?

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.PearlSupposed
string.value: What? Of course it's something you're supposed to be doing.

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.PearlProve
string.value: We need to prove that this office is the best, fastest, most thrifty, most efficient!

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.DeniseButWhy
string.value: But why, Pearl?!

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.DeniseDoingThis
string.value: Why are you doing this?

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.DeniseMiserable
string.value: Are you just trying to make us all miserable!?

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.PearlWhatNo
string.value: What? No!

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.DeniseBeenJust
string.value: Because you've been just...

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.DeniseActingLike
string.value: just acting like...

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.DeniseBigBully
string.value: a big bully!

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.PearlNecessary
string.value: Well, I... I suppose I felt it was necessary.

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.PearlDecades
string.value: I've been at this company for four decades!

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.PearlRespect
string.value: And do they appreciate me? Do they respect me?

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.PearlListen
string.value: I've given everything I have to offer to C.A.I. and they don't even listen to me!

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.PearlProveMyself
string.value: I had to... prove myself...

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.DeniseStillHere
string.value: Why are you even still here, then?

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.PearlWhaWhat
string.value: Wha... what?

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.DeniseDeserve
string.value: If C.A.I. has treated you so badly, then why not leave? Maybe they don't deserve you.

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.PearlCouldnt
string.value: Well... I couldn't just leave.

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.PearlLoyal
string.value: I mean, we all have our reasons for being loyal to this company...

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.WinstonBills
string.value: I'm just here because it pays the bills.

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.NadineCareer
string.value: Seemed like a good career move... at the time.

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.AshleyFreeze
string.value: Daddy said I had to get a job or he'd freeze my trust fund...

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.MahavirLadies
string.value: I do it all for the ladies!

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.DeniseSoHard
string.value: Do you even know why you're here, Pearl? Why you're working so hard?

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.DeniseMad
string.value: If it's just because you're mad at the company and feel like you have to prove what you already know...

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.PearlTrying
string.value: Yes. Yes, well. I see what you're all trying to tell me.

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.PearlBusiness
string.value: I... I had better go now, and think about some... take care of some business.

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.PearlMisbehave
string.value: Don't misbehave.

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.MahavirWow
string.value: Wow. I never thought I'd see that day.

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.PhonePerformance
string.value: Very impressive management performance.

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.DeniseWhoIsThat
string.value: Huh? Who... who is that?

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.WinstonCEO
string.value: I'd like to introduce you all to Brooke Conkling. The CEO of this company.

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.WinstonSpeakerphone
string.value: She asked to be on speakerphone if... certain events took place.

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.DeniseLegal
string.value: Is that even legal? Poor Pearl...

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.PhoneDontWorry
string.value: Now, don't worry about Pearl. She'll be well taken care of.

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.PhoneBusiness
string.value: We have more important business to attend to.

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.MahavirSleepy
string.value: What kind of business? I'm getting kind of sleepy again.

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.PhoneRestructuring
string.value: I've been monitoring your team, and I've decided it's time for a bit of corporate restructuring.

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.PhoneSuite
string.value: I want you all to report to the executive suite of the head office on Monday morning. That will be all!

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.DeniseCEO
string.value: The... CEO?

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.WinstonExpecting
string.value: Wow, even I wasn't expecting that.

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.DeniseWants
string.value: What do you think she wants?

string.name: cutscene.24Outro.MahavirMonday
string.value: Only one way to find out! See you all on Monday...

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.NadineOffices
string.value: Hm. So this is Conkling's executive office, eh?

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.MahavirSwank
string.value: Wow... this place is swank!

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.AshleyDump
string.value: It's not as nice as Daddy's boardroom, but I suppose it's better than that last dump!

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.WinstonSister
string.value: Hey guys. Let me introduce you to Brooke... also known as my big sister.

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.DeniseSister
string.value: The CEO is... your sister?

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.WinstonStory
string.value: It's a long story.

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.MahavirBorn
string.value: It all starts when Winston was born...

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.WinstonLong
string.value: Not that long.

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.WinstonInherited
string.value: She inherited the company from her husband, Alex Conkling Jr.

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.BrookeBro
string.value: Are you gossiping about me again, little bro?

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.BrookeFriends
string.value: Come on over here and bring your friends.

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.BrookeWorkout
string.value: I hope you don't mind if I don't interrupt my workout. I've got no time for dawdling.

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.BrookeConcentrate
string.value: I can't seem to concentrate unless I get enough exercise time in!

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.DeniseFIne
string.value: Oh... no, that's fine!

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.BrookePoint
string.value: I'll get right to the point.

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.BrookePreviously
string.value: I want you all working here, for me. I had a team under me previously, to help with various executive-level tasks.

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.BrookeFire
string.value: But I had to fire them. They weren't performing up to my standards, and it's easier for me to do things myself anyway.

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.MahavirBefore
string.value: Hmm, where have I heard that before?

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.BrookeEverything
string.value: No no, I know I can't do everything all the time! That's why you're here.

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.BrookeDelegate
string.value: I've been handling everything here just fine, but my therapist says I should reduce my stress and... delegate.

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.WinstonTechnical
string.value: Sis... you've been handling all the technical tasks here, too?

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.BrookeWinston
string.value: Yes, Winston!

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.BrookeHandle
string.value: Don't think I can't handle it!

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.WinstonOhGod
string.value: Oh, God no...

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.WinstonFileserver
string.value: I don't think I can bear to look at the state of the fileserver here...

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.BrookeFreak
string.value: Don't worry about him, he's a control freak.

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.MahavirFamily
string.value: Does it run in the family?

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.BrookeNiceThings
string.value: A couple other things. I know there are a lot of nice things in this office...

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.MahavirEnjoy
string.value: Yeah! A stereo system, air conditioning, all the amenities! I'm going to enjoy it here!

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.BrookeMinimum
string.value: ...but I'd prefer it if you guys kept that kind of thing to a minimum.

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.MahavirLost
string.value: Paradise... lost!

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.BrookeStockholders
string.value: I want the office to look fun and creative... really inspires the stockholders, you know?

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.BrookeWorkDone
string.value: But we need to get work done.

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.BrookeDistractions
string.value: Too many distractions are no good!

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.BrookeNoise
string.value: To be honest, even the noise of the A/C or that radio kind of bug me at times...

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.DeniseConkling
string.value: Don't worry, Ms. Conkling! I'm sure we can get everything done on schedule, and I know how to keep the team on task...

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.DeniseMahavir
string.value: Right, Mahavir?

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.MahavirEtTu
string.value: Et tu, Denise?

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.BrookeDenise
string.value: Oh yes, that reminds me... Denise, right?

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.BrookeChoco
string.value: You'll need to run to the store for choco-cafficinos.

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.BrookeThree
string.value: I drank three this morning, and...

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.BrookeOhMyGod
string.value: Oh my god!! No, oh no...

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.DeniseWhatIsIt
string.value: Oh! What is it?!

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.BrookeStanding
string.value: I've been standing in one spot for too long! I need to be working!

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.BrookeRest
string.value: And so do the rest of you!

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.DeniseNadine
string.value: Um... Nadine?

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.DenisePearls
string.value: I know we didn't really get off on the right foot, and that you're a friend of Pearl's, but...

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.NadineNot
string.value: No, I'm not.

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.DeniseExcuse
string.value: Excuse me?

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.NadineHeadhunter
string.value: I'm not a friend of Pearl's. She just recruited me through a headhunter.

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.DeniseCould
string.value: Oh! Well I thought maybe you and I could...

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.NadineCareer
string.value: I'm not really interested in being friends, Denise. I'm here for a reason: my career.

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.NadineConkling
string.value: And I'll tell you something: that Conkling woman has no idea what she's doing!

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.NadineTasks
string.value: You'd better let me handle the financial and writing tasks. It's what I was hired for.

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.NadineExercise
string.value: Hmph, using the office as her own personal exercise space.

string.name: cutscene.25Intro.DeniseInteresting
string.value: Well... this should be interesting.

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.MahavirBrooke
string.value: So... Ms. Conkling. Can I call you Brooke?

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.MahavirCEO
string.value: So you're a CEO, huh?

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.MahavirEnchanting
string.value: That sounds so... enchanting.

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.BrookeEnchanting
string.value: Yeah, sure. Enchanting.

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.BrookeFile
string.value: Where did I put that file?

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.MahavirWorkOut
string.value: And I really admire women who keep themselves fit. I work out myself too, you know!

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.BrookeKid
string.value: That's great, go with that, kid.

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.BrookeMahavir
string.value: Hmm. Mahavir, right? Can you get me another choco-cafficino, please?

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.MahavirBoss
string.value: Sure thing... boss.

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.DeniseSister
string.value: Can you believe it? Mahavir is even hitting on your sister!

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.WinstonCynical
string.value: I'm far too cynical not to believe something horrifying like that.

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.DeniseAshley
string.value: By the way, have you seen Ashley? She hasn't come in yet.

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.WinstonDitzy
string.value: Hmm, I haven't. But we have bigger problems than the disappearance of the ditzy debutante.

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.DeniseProblems
string.value: Bigger problems?

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.WinstonEmail
string.value: Check your e-mail. I just forwarded you a memo...

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.DeniseBoard
string.value: This is from the Board of Directors to Brooke! Winston, how did you...?

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.WinstonWays
string.value: I have my ways. The less you know about them, the better.

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.DeniseDemanding
string.value: Let's see... it's the end of the fiscal year and they're demanding...

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.DeniseOverages
string.value: that more work be completed to compensate for the budget overages?

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.WinstonBooks
string.value: Apparently she hasn't been keeping a close enough eye on the books.

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.WinstonUnread
string.value: Or keeping an eye on her e-mail. I doubt she's even read this. The girl's got something like 800 unread e-mails!

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.DeniseStaff
string.value: 'We're very disappointed to hear that you fired your personal staff again. If you can't keep the budget under control and delegate your responsibilities to a team, we will have to take drastic action.'

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.DeniseDrastic
string.value: Drastic action? What does that mean?

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.WinstonGetRidOf
string.value: It means they'll try to get rid of her.

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.WinstonCronies
string.value: They don't like her anyway! They're all cronies of her late husband, and never believed that she could take the reins.

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.WinstonBigots
string.value: Cigar-smoking bigots...

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.DeniseProve
string.value: Well, we're going to have to help her prove them wrong.

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.WinstonReally
string.value: Really? How on earth are you going to get her out of this fix?

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.WinstonPositive
string.value: They're demanding to see positive cash flow on a regular basis!

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.DeniseRunning
string.value: By doing what I do best... running this office!

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.DeniseBudget
string.value: Don't forget, I'm in charge of the budget here too. I can make sure we're in the black.

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.WinstonSaySo
string.value: If you say so... hmm.

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.WinstonPullItOff
string.value: I just think you might be able to pull it off.

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.WinstonIntercepting
string.value: Don't tell Brooke I was intercepting her e-mail.

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.WinstonSister
string.value: She's my big sister, but I have to keep an eye out for her, you know?

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.WinstonBomb
string.value: I love her, but she's almost TOO responsible. She turns into a walking stress-bomb on a regular basis, and can't even see the forest for the trees!

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.WinstonCrisis
string.value: And this whole crisis is a good example...

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.DeniseSecrets
string.value: I mean, I don't like keeping secrets, but...

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.WinstonAfford
string.value: It would just stress her out even more, and we can't afford that.

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.DeniseHope
string.value: I hope you're right about all this.

string.name: cutscene.26Intro.WinstonLikewise
string.value: Likewise, kiddo. Likewise.

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.AshleyNews
string.value: Hello, people! I'm back and do I ever have news for you!

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.NadineChoo
string.value: Let me guess. Jimmy Choo sample sale?

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.AshleyMarried
string.value: Even better! I know that's hard to believe. I'm getting married!

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.AshleyHitched
string.value: Married! Hitched! Tying the knot!

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.MahavirCongratulations
string.value: Congratulations! Who's the lucky guy?

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.AshleyCharles
string.value: His name is Charles, and he's a hedge fund manager!

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.AshleyProposal
string.value: Oh, his proposal was so romantic, we were on the French Riviera...

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.DeniseFancy
string.value: Wow, fancy! So that's where you were yesterday!

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.AshleyNadine
string.value: Yes! I'll have to tell you all about it, Denise! You too, Nadine!

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.AshleyLucky
string.value: And then, one day... you'll be as lucky as me...

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.NadineDream
string.value: One can only dream.

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.AshleyRock
string.value: I don't need to dream. Wait until you see the ROCK he got me! I'm afraid to even wear it in this seedy neighborhood.

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.BrookeWork
string.value: People, don't you have work to do? All this noise is driving me nuts!

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.AshleyBoss
string.value: Ooh, better not make your boss mad!

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.AshleyStiffs
string.value: Hee hee! You poor working stiffs.

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.NadineBoss
string.value: Excuse me? She's your boss, too.

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.AshleyWorking
string.value: Not for much longer. Wheeee! You don't expect me to keep working here, do you?

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.DeniseMarried
string.value: What? When are you getting married?

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.AshleyWeekend
string.value: This weekend!

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.AshleySticking
string.value: I'm not sticking around here much longer, that's for sure! No more menial art tasks for me now that I am part of the global elite.

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.DeniseHappy
string.value: Oh... I'm so... happy for you, but don't you think this is a little rushed?

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.AshleyDelightful
string.value: Mrs. Charles Babbington III... how delightful it sounds!

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.MahavirHappy
string.value: You don't sound overwhelmingly happy for her...

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.DeniseMahavir
string.value: Oh, Mahavir...

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.DeniseFour
string.value: It's just that I'm not sure what we're going to do with only four employees!

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.MahavirArt
string.value: Oh no... don't tell me I'm going to have to do art tasks again!?

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.DeniseEventually
string.value: Well, you might have to eventually...

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.DeniseAshley
string.value: And I don't know if Ashley will be too happy about doing them anymore either.

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.MahavirInjustice
string.value: Oh, the injustice of this cruel, cruel world!

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.NadineSister
string.value: Say, Winston... has your sister always been such an exercise nut?

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.WinstonGenes
string.value: Pretty much, yeah. I inherited the computer couch potato genes, and she got the yoga marathon ones.

string.name: cutscene.27Intro.NadineSomething
string.value: Hmm, maybe the adrenaline is the secret to her success! She must have been able to hang onto this job somehow...

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.DeniseAshley
string.value: All right, even though Ashley's left the team, everyone's hard at work, so...

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.BrookeProblem
string.value: No, no. That's why I needed to talk to you. That's exactly the problem!

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.DeniseUmWhat
string.value: Um... what?

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.BrookeExecutive
string.value: I respect everyone's abilities here, but this is sensitive high-level executive work!

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.BrookeAttention
string.value: Frankly, there's a lot of stuff that demands my attention, and my attention alone!

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.DeniseDelegate
string.value: But... didn't you say you wanted to delegate?

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.BrookeDelegate
string.value: I can only delegate when it's appropriate to delegate!

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.BrookeHands
string.value: Having everyone's clammy hands all over these projects... ack, I can't handle it any more!

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.BrookeStressed
string.value: Phew, sorry. I'm a little bit stressed out.

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.DeniseYouDontSay
string.value: You don't say.

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.BrookeLetGo
string.value: It's hard for me to let go of some of this stuff, you know?

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.BrookeAlone
string.value: I'll tell you what, give me at least a day to get some stuff sorted out, alone.

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.DeniseWork
string.value: What, you don't want anyone else to work?

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.BrookePeople
string.value: Augh, you people!

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.BrookePayYou
string.value: Isn't it enough that I pay you?

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.BrookeAnnoys
string.value: I'll even try to put up with people hanging around here and sleeping or playing music, as much as it annoys me.

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.DeniseOkay
string.value: Oh... okay, I guess!

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.BrookeThanks
string.value: Thanks! I better get back to work.

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.NadineAcceptable
string.value: Not acceptable.

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.WinstonRight
string.value: Much as I hate to admit it, she's right.

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.NadineExperts
string.value: She can't bring us in here, experts in our field, and then try to maintain such tight control of the accounting workflow!

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.WinstonTechnical
string.value: Or the technical tasks. I shudder to think...

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.DeniseGood
string.value: But guys... she really is pretty good at all of that.

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.NadineJack
string.value: A jack of all trades and a master of none, is what you mean!

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.NadineSystems
string.value: And we have systems to keep these things running efficiently! We can't have her running around like a loose cannon.

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.WinstonSyndrome
string.value: It is pretty typical 'CEO Syndrome.'

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.DeniseOkOk
string.value: OK, OK... I'll see what we can do!

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.DeniseAtLeast
string.value: Just give me at least a day...

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.DeniseMahavir
string.value: Mahavir... what are you doing over here?

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.DeniseWow
string.value: Wow... you really are!

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.MahavirAshley
string.value: Not like I have anything better to do... and Ashley left behind lots of art tasks.

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.DeniseArt
string.value: Wait a second... art tasks?

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.DeniseWhatsWrong
string.value: What's wrong?

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.DeniseNap
string.value: Usually you're so eager to go and take a nap, or hang out and chat, or something...

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.MahavirRunOut
string.value: Alas, that was the old Mahavir. I've finally run out!

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.DeniseRunOut
string.value: Run out? Of what?

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.MahavirLadies
string.value: Of lovely ladies to bestow the gift of my mellifluous words upon!

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.MahavirRejected
string.value: I've been rejected by every last girl in this company now, I think!

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.MahavirJourney
string.value: And so the futile journey of Mahavir... comes to an end.

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.DeniseRejected
string.value: Huh? I never rejected you.

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.MahavirFlirt
string.value: Really? You said you weren't here to flirt with me...

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.DeniseSilly
string.value: That's not a rejection, silly! I just want to make sure we get work done...

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.MahavirBusiness
string.value: Well, then! Mahavir is still in business!

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.MahavirCooler
string.value: Meet me at the water cooler, cutie!

string.name: cutscene.28Intro.DeniseNormal
string.value: Phew, he's back to normal! I guess I'm relieved...

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.DenisePhew
string.value: Phew! What a long week, I'm glad it's finally over.

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.MahavirAlmost
string.value: Almost ready to go?

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.DeniseDoing
string.value: What are you still doing here?

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.DeniseFriday
string.value: It's Friday night, don't you have a club or warehouse or something to be at?

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.MahavirPlans
string.value: Eh, nah. My plans fell through.

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.MahavirBut
string.value: But hey...

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.MahavirCoffee
string.value: I was wondering, do you want to get a cup of coffee or something?

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.DeniseChatting
string.value: Hah, is this what I get for chatting with you at the water cooler earlier?

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.DeniseDate
string.value: Oh my gosh. Mahavir, are you actually asking me on a DATE?

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.DeniseTalk
string.value: And here I thought you were all talk!

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.MahavirNoNo
string.value: What? No no, it's not necessarily a date.

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.MahavirIMean
string.value: I mean, um...

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.MahavirEvening
string.value: A romantic evening with Mahavir is infinitely more precious and hard to come by than a cup of coffee!

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.DeniseSimple
string.value: Well all right then, why don't we try something a little more simple.

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.DeniseCoffee
string.value: You know I don't drink coffee though!

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.MahavirSoda
string.value: One diet soda it is!

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.MahavirActually
string.value: Actually, though...

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.MahavirBadNews
string.value: I wanted to take you out to give you a little bad news. But I might as well tell you now.

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.DeniseBadNews
string.value: Bad news?

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.MahavirOut
string.value: I have to be out of the office for a while again...

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.MahavirHectic
string.value: I know it's really hectic, I'm sorry!

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.DeniseOhNo
string.value: Oh, no!

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.DeniseTiming
string.value: The timing couldn't be worse! We're losing people like crazy!

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.DeniseNow
string.value: Does it have to be now?

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.MahavirAfraid
string.value: Afraid so.

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.MahavirPooja
string.value: My aunt Pooja just passed away.

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.MahavirLawyer
string.value: She was a famous lawyer. All the cousins are squabbling over her inheritance, but her will says she wants to donate it all to some civil rights fund!

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.DeniseMahavir
string.value: Mahavir, I don't know what to say.

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.MahavirSorry
string.value: I'm sorry, my family drama is the last thing you need to worry about, huh?

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.DeniseManage
string.value: I'm sure we'll manage somehow.

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.MahavirDefinitely
string.value: You definitely will.

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.MahavirReplacement
string.value: Because here's the good news, I've arranged for a replacement!

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.MahavirSurprise
string.value: I wanted it to be a surprise but I don't want you to be worried either...

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.DeniseHire
string.value: What, you managed to hire someone?

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.MahavirReHired
string.value: Just temporarily, and more like re-hired...

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.MahavirArtTasks
string.value: It's someone you know... who's really good with art tasks !

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.DeniseAshley
string.value: Ashley's coming back?! But she's on her honeymoon!

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.MahavirSilly
string.value: No, silly! Think further back.

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.MahavirNeverMind
string.value: Oh, never mind... you'll see.

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.DeniseThink
string.value: Ohhhh! I think I know who you mean.

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.DeniseGreat
string.value: It'll be great to see her again!

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.DeniseSoda
string.value: Hey, let's go get that soda. Or heck, maybe I'll have a choco-cafficino for a change!

string.name: cutscene.28Outro.MahavirMilady
string.value: After you, milady!

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.DeniseMahavir
string.value: So... Mahavir's out of town.

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.DeniseReport
string.value: And you say the annual report has to be designed?

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.BrookeSameTime
string.value: Yep, same time every year. Lots of art tasks !

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.BrookeLots
string.value: Lots of every kind of task, but lots and lots of art tasks !

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.BrookePhotoshop
string.value: Last year I did it all by myself, I'm pretty handy with Photoshop!

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.BrookeHandle
string.value: Look, you can just give all these tasks to me if you want! I can definitely handle it!

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.WinstonBelieve
string.value: I can't believe her sometimes.

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.WinstonThinking
string.value: What was I thinking, coming to work in the same room with her?

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.WinstonComputers
string.value: This is just like when I was a kid. Do you know why I got so into computers?

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.DeniseNerdy
string.value: Because... you're just nerdy like that?

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.WinstonInsist
string.value: Well yeah, but it was also the only thing that she didn't insist on being the best at!

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.WinstonTaken
string.value: And now even that's been taken away from me!

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.DeniseWorry
string.value: Winston! Don't worry, it's not the end of the world.

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.DeniseArtTasks
string.value: But all these art tasks might be!

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.DeniseReplacement
string.value: Although, Mahavir did say a replacement was coming for him! An artist, and I think I know who she is!

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.WinstonTara
string.value: Oh my god, that's what that's all about? But that would mean Tara, and...

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.DeniseAndWhat
string.value: And what...?

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.TimothyDudettes
string.value: Hey, dudes and dudettes! Timothy G is back in the hizzouse! All right!

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.WinstonMixUp
string.value: I think there was a mix-up.

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.TimothyMainMan
string.value: Denise! Winston, my main man!

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.TimothyDigs
string.value: You got some nice digs here, really come up in the world!

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.WinstonMainMan
string.value: I'm not your main man, dude.

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.TimothyWhatever
string.value: Whatever! I'm here to save the day, I got the request this morning.

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.TimothyChilling
string.value: And you know, I'm just chilling these days, so I thought I'd come over and help out.

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.DeniseTimothy
string.value: Timothy, I...

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.TimothyCheeks
string.value: You don't need to say a thing, sweet cheeks. Just point Timothy at the financial tasks.

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.NadineWhat
string.value: What was that?!

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.NadineTalk
string.value: Denise, I won't stand for this. We need to have a discussion about who's qualified to handle the finances.

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.DeniseOhDear
string.value: Oh dear...

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.TimothyTechnical
string.value: Or the technical tasks ! Heck, I bet I can do more than Winston around here.

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.WinstonServers
string.value: Oh come on, am I supposed to believe this nonsense? Stay out of my servers!

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.TimothyStressed
string.value: Don't get so stressed, Winston, my brother from another mother.

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.TimothyTalk
string.value: Perhaps we can share professional know-how on the networking thinga-majingy.

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.WinstonStroganoff
string.value: Keep your stroganoff-smelling "know-how" to yourself, "bro". I don't have the time today.

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.WinstonArtTasks
string.value: And I hope you like art tasks.

string.name: cutscene.29Intro.TimothyJoking
string.value: He was joking about the art tasks, right Denise?

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.WinstonDeal
string.value: So that's the deal.

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.WinstonGoals
string.value: We have to reach these budget goals, while also keeping my sister from getting fired for bad management practices.

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.WinstonHospital
string.value: Not to mention keeping her from getting so stressed out that she ends up in the hospital!

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.TimothyParty
string.value: Wow, no wonder you guys aren't in party mode.

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.WinstonParty
string.value: I don't DO party mode.

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.BrookeStressed
string.value: I really can't TAKE much more of this! I'm so stressed out, it's like, it's like...

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.BrookeNerve
string.value: A calypso band is playing my temples like a pair of steel drums!!!

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.DeniseMaybe
string.value: Oh, um... well maybe we can...

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.BrookeOtherHand
string.value: On the other hand...

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.BrookeOver
string.value: At least it's all pretty much over now!

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.WinstonSayWhat
string.value: Say what?

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.BrookeBreak
string.value: Yep. It's about time, too... I really need to take a break!

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.DeniseTargets
string.value: But... there's still a lot of work to do! And um... the budget targets...

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.BrookeBudget
string.value: The budget? Oh, whatever. Don't worry about that stuff.

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.WinstonKnew
string.value: Are you out of your mind?

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.BrookePeople
string.value: Not at all! I'm finally right back in my mind, where I belong.

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.WinstonButBut
string.value: But... but...!

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.BrookeCalmDownLilBro
string.value: Hey, calm down, little bro! I plan on trying to relax for a bit.

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.BrookeCleanseCenterStill
string.value: Cleanse my system, center myself, achieve stillness...

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.WinstonCenterStillYou
string.value: Centered and still?! You?

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.DeniseWhatAboutBoard
string.value: But Brooke... what about the board of directors?

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.BrookeDontWorryBoard
string.value: Those guys? Hah, what are you worrying about them for?

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.BrookeWeCanHandle
string.value: Believe me, there's nothing to stress about. I know there's some work to be done, but I'm sure we can handle it.

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.NadineBrookeCarefree
string.value: Well, she certainly seems carefree about all of this.

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.DeniseWhatHappenedBrooke
string.value: I don't get it! What happened?

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.WinstonMrStroganoff
string.value: Maybe she's having a nervous breakdown, like with Mr. Stroganoff over here.

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.TimothyStepOff
string.value: Hey, step off the stroganoff, "little bro!"

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.NadineSlackingOff
string.value: She's slacking off. Which means she'll be fired for incompetence!

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.NadineAllFired
string.value: ... and that means all of us will be fired too.

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.DeniseGuysGuys
string.value: Guys... Guys!

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.DeniseSabbatical
string.value: Come on, there's still a lot of work to do. We're going to have to make up for Brooke's... um... short sabbatical.

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.NadineSabbaticalRich
string.value: Hah! Short sabbatical, that's rich.

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.MahavirCrisis
string.value: Fear not, dear coworkers, I've returned to avert the crisis!

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.DeniseMahavir
string.value: Oh, Mahavir...

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.MahavirWork
string.value: And I, Mahavir, swear that I'll actually work for a change, until we're out of this fix!

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.WinstonMiraclesDoHappen
string.value: Well, I guess miracles do happen... but it might not be enough this time.

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.WinstonContingencyPlan
string.value: Denise, we're going to need to develop a contingency plan.

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.DeniseBoardNotHappy
string.value: You're right... I don't think the board is going to be too happy about Brooke dropping her duties to... um... cleanse her system?

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.DeniseRemindWeirdEmail
string.value: Oh, and Winston, remind me to tell you about this weird e-mail I got from the board, too...

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.WinstonEnoughWorryAbout
string.value: What? As if we didn't have enough to worry about!

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.MahavirActingSerious
string.value: Wow, they sure are acting serious lately...

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.NadinePuberty
string.value: Maybe because they actually managed to make it through puberty, unlike some people?

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.NadineOwnPlans
string.value: Hmm... I'm going to have to make my own plans. That Brooke Conkling must know something about this company that I don't.

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.MahavirNoFunAnymore
string.value: Damn. This place is no fun anymore.

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.TimothyAllTurnOut
string.value: I know just how you feel. I wonder how it's all going to turn out?

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.TimothyBleakSolution
string.value: You know what I do when everything seems bleak?

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.MahavirNoNoNo
string.value: Oh, no. A thousand times no.

string.name: cutscene.30Intro.MahavirNoStroganoff
string.value: I can guess, but no, I don't want any stroganoff!

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.DeniseHitTheBudget
string.value: Well, we made it so far, and we even hit the required budget numbers...

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.WinstonBoardScreaming
string.value: Good work, but I'm afraid the board's still screaming bloody murder about Brooke's performance.

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.WinstonBoardDemanding
string.value: They're demanding even more loudly that she be dismissed.

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.WinstonFirePersonalStaff
string.value: And if she gets fired... her "personal staff" will undoubtedly be cut too.

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.DenisePersonalStaff
string.value: Personal staff...

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.DeniseYouMeanUs
string.value: Wait, you mean us?!

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.DeniseWhatToDo
string.value: Oh, geez... what are we going to do?

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.DeniseWorkedHard
string.value: After we worked so hard to meet the board's budget projections, too...

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.BrookeBudget
string.value: The budget?

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.BrookeBoardComplaints
string.value: Are you guys still talking about the budget problems the board was complaining about?

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.WinstonHuhKnew
string.value: Huh? You knew about that?

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.BrookeFogeys
string.value: People. People! Those fogeys on the board have been threatening me with that kind of thing for years.

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.BrookeRest
string.value: They're not going to rest until they've kicked me out of the CEO chair.

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.BrookeLetting
string.value: Which is why I plan on letting them!

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.DeniseLetting
string.value: Letting them?!

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.DeniseFire
string.value: You mean... you're going to let them fire you?

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.BrookeOutOfHere
string.value: I already did! I'm no longer the CEO, as of last night.

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.WinstonQuitting
string.value: So you're... quitting?

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.BrookeRacket
string.value: I'm tired of this racket.

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.BrookeWorkingButtOff
string.value: I've just been working my butt off for the last few weeks to make sure this company doesn't fall apart at the seams after I leave.

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.BrookeBaby
string.value: It was my late husband's pride and joy, after all. But he's gone, and I can't stay tied to it forever!

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.DeniseGoals
string.value: So all of the budget goals we were trying to hit...

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.BrookeImportant
string.value: They were still really important, believe me.

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.BrookeWrap
string.value: Kept the board off my back while I wrapped everything up!

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.BrookeTheUsual
string.value: All of the work we've been doing... well, some of it was the usual, the annual report, that kind of thing.

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.BrookeByLaws
string.value: But a lot of it was so that I could restructure the company bylaws.

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.WinstonDontMean
string.value: You don't mean...

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.BrookeBoardCantRun
string.value: Yep. The board may have gotten me out of the executive chair, but that doesn't mean they'll be able to run the company however they want!

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.BrookeLastProblem
string.value: There is one last problem, though.

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.DeniseWhatNow
string.value: Oh, no, what is it now?

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.BrookeNotWorry
string.value: Hahaha! Nothing to worry about.

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.BrookeProfitSharing
string.value: You see, some of the policy changes I just made have to do with profit-sharing. The board's not going to like that!

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.WinstonWaitYouMean
string.value: Wait, you mean...

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.BrookeBonusChecks
string.value: I just need to figure out how to funnel all this extra budget you've been earning back into fat bonus checks for all of you!

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.WinstonFittingLast
string.value: A very fitting last act as CEO!

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.TimothyMuchachos
string.value: Well muchachos, it looks like I'm not needed here any more... so I'm going to ride off, into the sunset!

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.BrookeTakeCare
string.value: I need to take care of a few things before leaving myself.

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.DeniseEmail
string.value: Wow, that totally explains the weird e-mail I got... and I thought it was a mistake!

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.WinstonEmail
string.value: Weird e-mail?

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.DeniseBoard
string.value: Yeah, I guess they're offering me a promotion now that Brooke is leaving...

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.MahavirNextCEO
string.value: Wait, you mean YOU'RE going to be the next CEO?

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.DeniseNothing
string.value: Oh! No no, nothing like that!

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.DenisePromotion
string.value: They just offered me a promotion to interim coordinator...

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.DeniseManage
string.value: You know, to manage the office, and some other things... until they find a new executive, I guess?

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.WinstonWhoKnows
string.value: And who knows when that will be!

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.MahavirExciting
string.value: How exciting! Denise at the reins... and I have her ear, like the power behind the throne!

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.DeniseWhile
string.value: You really think it would be a while until they find someone, Winston?

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.DenisePressure
string.value: I... I don't know if I really want that much pressure on me...

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.WinstonAdvice
string.value: All joking aside, I only have one piece of advice.

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.WinstonDont
string.value: For god's sake, don't take a job like that unless you really want to do it.

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.DeniseDontKnow
string.value: I... I just don't know!

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.WinstonDontKnow
string.value: I think that's your problem, Denise. You don't know what you want!

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.DeniseReally
string.value: What... really?

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.DeniseLike
string.value: I mean, I like this job in a lot of ways...

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.WinstonHelping
string.value: I think what you like is helping other people.

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.WinstonYourself
string.value: But what do you want for yourself, Denise?

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.DeniseThought
string.value: Wow. I haven't really thought about that this whole time. I just needed a job.

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.DeniseHappy
string.value: What about you, Winston? Are you happy here?

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.WinstonStuff
string.value: Eh, not really. It's a job. But I've got other stuff going on.

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.MahavirLife
string.value: Really? You have a life?

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.WinstonBass
string.value: I don't talk about it much here. I play bass in a jazz quartet, and I just joined a mountain-climbing club. That kind of thing.

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.MahavirHangovers
string.value: I'm impressed. I usually just recover from hangovers on weekends!

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.WinstonLifer
string.value: Yeah, you're not a 'lifer' like me. This place drives me crazy sometimes.

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.WinstonIdiots
string.value: But as long as I keep my head down and the idiots off my case, it suits me just fine for eight hours a day.

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.MahavirYear
string.value: Whereas I don't think I'll be around this place more than a year or so, in any case.

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.DenisePlans
string.value: I totally haven't thought about my plans like you guys!

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.WinstonFuture
string.value: Don't sweat it, kid! The future's wide open.

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.WinstonOutOfHere
string.value: And speaking of eight hours, and the future, I need to get out of here.

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.MahavirRun
string.value: I have to run too, cute stuff... you gonna be ok?

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.DeniseIThink
string.value: Yeah... you know what? I think I will be!

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.DeniseWork
string.value: After all, work isn't everything!

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.CaptionTheEnd
string.value: The End

string.name: cutscene.30Outro.CaptionOrIsIt
string.value: ... well, there's a little more, actually.
